items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉美債殖利率拉回 黃金反彈逾1%
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: US Treasury Yields Pull Back, Gold Rebounds Over 1%
paras: 金價周三(2日)從前日觸及的一個月低點反彈，主因是美債殖利率與美元從近期高點下滑，投資人也在等待本周即將公布的非農就業數據，以獲取與聯準會(Fed)貨幣政策方向有關的線索。

黃金現貨上漲1.1%，報每盎司4376.41美元，從盤中稍早觸及的8月7日低點反彈。
12月交割的黃金期貨收高0.4%，報每盎司4414.0美元。


High Ridge Futures金屬交易主管David Meger說：「金價能重新回到平盤之上，原因之一是美債殖利率略為下滑，讓金價得以從近期低點反彈。未來能源市場走勢與殖利率，仍將是影響黃金市場的主要焦點。」
美元也從接近3周高點回落。
紐約聯邦準備銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)表示，長天期債券殖利率上升並非出於通膨疑慮，而是反映美國經濟基本面穩健。
另一方面，美國8月民間就業成長不如市場預期，但金價反應不大，投資人正等待周五公布的非農就業報告，以取得更多經濟與利率走向的線索。
StoneX市場分析主管Rhona O'Connell表示：「ADP數據的可靠性不高，它或許會為非農就業報告定下基調，但非農數據對市場而言無疑才是最重要的指標。」
芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具顯示，交易員目前預估Fed 9月決策會議上升息的機率為64%。
此外，荷蘭央行表示，過去六個月已將86公噸黃金從紐約與渥太華運往倫敦，以提高黃金交易便利性，並強化危機應變準備。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀上漲1.2%，報每盎司65.03美元。
現貨白金上漲0.9%，報每盎司1756.39美元。
現貨鈀金上漲3.2%，報每盎司1352.74美元。
paras_en: Gold prices rebounded on Wednesday (the 2nd) from the one‑month low hit the day before, mainly because US Treasury yields and the dollar slipped from recent peaks, and investors are awaiting this week’s non‑farm payroll data for clues on the Federal Reserve’s policy direction.

Spot gold rose 1.1% to $4,376.41 per ounce, bouncing back from the intraday low reached earlier on August 7. December‑delivery gold futures gained 0.4% to $4,414.0 per ounce. David Meger, metals trading head at High Ridge Futures, said: “One reason gold could get back above the flat line is the slight dip in US Treasury yields, allowing gold to rebound from recent lows. Going forward, energy market trends and yields will remain the main focus for the gold market.”
The dollar also fell back from a near‑three‑week high.
New York Fed President John Williams said the rise in long‑term bond yields is not driven by inflation concerns but reflects a solid US economic foundation.

Meanwhile, US private‑sector employment growth in August fell short of expectations, but gold’s reaction was muted as investors await Friday’s non‑farm payroll report for more insight into the economy and rate trajectory.

StoneX market analyst Rhona O’Connell noted: “ADP data are not very reliable; they may set the tone for the payroll report, but the payroll numbers are undoubtedly the most important indicator for the market.”
The CME FedWatch tool shows traders currently assign a 64% probability that the Fed will raise rates at its September decision meeting.

In addition, the Dutch central bank said it has moved 86 metric tons of gold from New York and Ottawa to London over the past six months to improve trading convenience and strengthen crisis‑response preparedness.
Other precious‑metal trading: Spot silver rose 1.2% to $65.03 per ounce. Spot platinum gained 0.9% to $1,756.39 per ounce. Spot palladium jumped 3.2% to $1,352.74 per ounce.

items.title: 川普政府出招了！拒報非法移民恐失數十億美元聯邦福利資金
items.title_en: Trump Administration Takes Action: Refusal to Report Illegal Immigrants Could Cost Tens of Billions in Federal Welfare Funds
paras: 美國司法部祭出新解釋，要求所有接受聯邦福利資金的州政府機關，將已知非法居留者資訊通報國土安全部，否則可能面臨數十億美元聯邦補助遭削減的風險。這項政策被視為川普政府擴大移民執法、進一步要求州政府配合聯邦移民機關的重要一步，也可能引發民主黨主政州的新一輪法律挑戰。

美國司法部(Department of Justice, DOJ)法律顧問辦公室(Office of Legal Counsel, OLC)9月1日發布法律意見，重新解釋1996年「個人責任與工作機會調和法」(Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act, PRWORA)中的移民資訊通報規定，認定只要州政府選擇接受「貧困家庭臨時援助」(Temporary Assistance for Needy Families, TANF)及「補充保障收入」(Supplemental Security Income, SSI)相關聯邦資金，整個州政府所有機關都必須將已知未合法居留美國的人員資訊通報美國國土安全部(DHS)。
這代表通報義務不再只限於直接負責管理TANF或SSI計畫的州政府機構。根據司法部的新解釋，包括州立大學、汽車監理機關(DMV)等其他可能掌握移民身分資訊的州政府部門，只要知道相關人士處於非法居留狀態，也可能必須向DHS提供資訊。
司法部副助理司法部長Joshua Craddock在法律意見中表示，未遵守規定可能面臨「嚴重後果」，包括失去相關聯邦計畫資金。司法部強調，這項法律意見不是新的法律，而是恢復國會原先制定法規時的意義，並撤回1998年克林頓政府時期採取的較狹義解釋。
司法部助理司法部長T. Elliot Gaiser則表示，國會在1996年法律中已明確規定相關義務，州政府一旦選擇接受TANF資金，就必須遵守資訊通報要求。司法部認為，原本的1998年法律意見將「State」狹義解釋為負責執行福利計畫的特定州政府機關，縮小了國會原先設定的義務範圍，因此正式撤回該意見。
不過，這項新解釋採取「向前適用」原則，州政府過去依照1998年舊解釋所做的決定，不會因此遭到追溯處罰。司法部表示，聯邦機關將可依據新的法律標準，更新TANF及SSI的補助協議與合規程序。
目前全美50州、華盛頓特區以及多個美國領地都參與TANF及SSI相關計畫。司法部指出，TANF每年聯邦補助金超過164億美元，SSI聯邦福利支出則超過600億美元，因此若州政府拒絕配合，可能面臨相當龐大的聯邦資金壓力。
需要注意的是，無合法身分的移民本身並不符合TANF或SSI福利資格。這次政策的核心並非允許非法居留者取得福利，而是要求州政府把其他機關掌握的非法居留身分資訊交給聯邦移民執法機關。
新政策也可能擴大DHS取得移民資訊的來源。至少19州及華盛頓特區允許沒有合法移民身分的人申請駕照，因此州政府汽車監理機關可能掌握大量相關紀錄；此外，多個州立大學也招收沒有合法移民身分的學生。這意味著移民資訊可能不再只存在於福利機構，而是分散於州政府不同部門。
川普自2025年1月重返白宮後，持續推動大規模移民執法行動，包括擴大移民及海關執法局(ICE)行動、在多座城市部署移民執法人員，並尋求與州及地方執法機關合作，以追查涉嫌違反移民法的人員。近期聯邦政府也持續要求州政府提供駕照、選民名冊及其他政府資料，並以聯邦資金作為施壓手段。
這波政策已引發民主黨主政州與川普政府之間的法律衝突。就在司法部發布最新法律意見前一個月，紐約、加州、科羅拉多、伊利諾、麻州、明尼蘇達、紐澤西等23州及華盛頓特區，已就另一項TANF資料共享政策提告，反對聯邦政府擴大取得福利受領人的個人資料。該訴訟由紐約州等地方政府於8月3日向華盛頓特區聯邦法院提出，目前已提出初步禁制令申請。
這起訴訟涉及的是美國衛生與公共服務部(HHS)旗下兒童與家庭管理局(ACF)6月發布的資料政策。該政策擬擴大聯邦政府取得TANF受領人資料的權限，包括社會安全號碼、地址、移民身分等敏感資訊，並可能與DHS等其他聯邦機關共享。多州政府主張，這種資料共享超出聯邦政府對TANF的法定權限，也違反行政程序及聯邦隱私保護規定。
參與訴訟的州政府認為，若福利申請人擔心個人資料可能被交給移民執法機關，可能導致符合資格的家庭不敢申請福利，進而削弱TANF原本協助低收入家庭及兒童脫離貧困的政策目的。訴訟文件指出，TANF全美約涉及240萬名受助者。
這並非川普政府第一次以聯邦資金要求州政府配合移民政策。近年聯邦政府已在選民資料、食品援助及商業駕照資料等議題上，要求州政府提供更完整的個人資訊，部分民主黨主政州則透過法院阻止或限制資料共享。8月，伊利諾州等多州也針對聯邦政府要求取得約1700萬名商業駕照持有人資料的措施提出法律挑戰。
對川普政府而言，最新法律意見提供了一個更廣泛的法律依據，讓DHS可以透過州政府不同部門取得非法居留者資訊；對州政府而言，接受數十億美元聯邦補助與維持州政府對個人資料的管理權之間，則可能形成新的政策與法律拉鋸。
由於OLC法律意見對聯邦行政機關具有拘束力，但本身並不等同於國會通過的新法律，州政府若拒絕配合，最終是否真的會遭到削減TANF或SSI相關資金，以及這些資金條件是否符合美國憲法與相關聯邦法律，仍可能交由法院裁決。
在2026年期中選舉逼近之際，移民政策已成為川普政府與民主黨主政州之間的重要政治與法律戰場。最新通報要求若全面落地，將使州政府各部門與聯邦移民執法機關之間的資訊交換大幅增加，也可能成為下一波移民政策訴訟的焦點。
paras_en: The U.S. Department of Justice has issued a new interpretation requiring every state government agency that receives federal welfare funds to report known illegal residents to the Department of Homeland Security, or risk having tens of billions of dollars in federal aid cut. The policy is seen as a major step in the Trump administration’s effort to expand immigration enforcement and compel state cooperation with federal immigration authorities, and could spark a new round of legal challenges from Democratic‑led states.

On September 1, the Department of Justice’s Office of Legal Counsel released a legal opinion re‑interpreting the immigration‑information‑reporting provision of the 1996 Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act (PRWORA). The opinion holds that any state that chooses to accept federal money tied to Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI) must have all its agencies report any known persons residing in the United States illegally to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

This means the reporting duty is no longer limited to the state agencies that directly administer TANF or SSI. Under the DOJ’s new reading, other state entities that may possess immigration‑status information—such as state universities and motor‑vehicle departments (DMVs)—must also provide DHS with information on individuals they know to be unlawfully present.

Deputy Assistant Attorney General Joshua Craddock wrote in the opinion that failure to comply could have “serious consequences,” including loss of the related federal program funding. The DOJ stressed that the opinion does not create new law but restores the original congressional intent of the statute and revokes the narrower interpretation adopted in 1998 during the Clinton administration.

Assistant Attorney General T. Elliot Gaiser added that Congress explicitly mandated the reporting obligation in the 1996 law, and that any state that accepts TANF funds must obey it. The DOJ said the 1998 opinion had narrowly defined “State” to mean only the agencies that run the welfare programs, thereby shrinking the congressional duty, and that opinion is now formally withdrawn.

However, the new interpretation applies prospectively, so states’ past decisions made under the 1998 guidance will not be punished retroactively. The DOJ said federal agencies will be able to update TANF and SSI grant agreements and compliance procedures to reflect the new legal standard.

All 50 states, the District of Columbia and several U.S. territories currently participate in TANF and SSI programs. The DOJ noted that TANF receives more than $16.4 billion in federal assistance each year, while SSI expenditures exceed $60 billion, so a state that refuses to cooperate could face a substantial loss of federal dollars.

It is important to note that undocumented immigrants are not themselves eligible for TANF or SSI benefits. The policy’s focus is not to grant benefits to illegal residents but to require states to turn over immigration‑status information held by other agencies to federal immigration‑enforcement authorities.

The new rule could broaden DHS’s sources of immigration data. At least 19 states and D.C. allow people without legal immigration status to obtain driver’s licenses, meaning motor‑vehicle agencies may hold large numbers of relevant records. In addition, many state universities enroll students who lack legal status. Thus, immigration information may no longer be confined to welfare agencies but spread across various state departments.

Since returning to the White House in January 2025, Trump has continued to push large‑scale immigration‑enforcement actions, expanding ICE operations, deploying immigration officers in multiple cities, and seeking cooperation from state and local law‑enforcement to track alleged immigration‑law violators. The federal government has also been demanding state‑level data such as driver‑license rolls, voter registries and other records, using federal funding as leverage.

The policy has already sparked legal conflict between Democratic‑run states and the Trump administration. A month before the DOJ issued its latest opinion, New York, California, Colorado, Illinois, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey and 22 other states plus D.C. filed a lawsuit challenging a separate TANF data‑sharing rule that would expand federal access to beneficiaries’ personal information. The suit was filed by New York and other state officials on August 3 in a federal court in D.C., and a preliminary injunction has been sought.

The lawsuit concerns a data‑sharing policy issued in June by the Administration for Children and Families (ACF) within the Department of Health and Human Services. The policy would broaden federal access to TANF recipient data—including Social Security numbers, addresses and immigration status—and could allow sharing with DHS and other agencies. Several states argue that the rule exceeds the statutory authority granted to the federal government over TANF and violates administrative‑procedure and privacy statutes.

Participating states contend that if welfare applicants fear their personal data could be handed over to immigration enforcement, eligible families may avoid applying for benefits, undermining TANF’s purpose of helping low‑income families and children escape poverty. The filing notes that TANF serves roughly 2.4 million recipients nationwide.

This is not the first time the Trump administration has used federal funding to pressure states to cooperate on immigration matters. In recent years the federal government has sought state‑provided data on voter rolls, food‑aid recipients and commercial driver’s‑license holders, and Democratic‑led states have often blocked or limited such sharing through the courts. In August, Illinois and several other states challenged a federal request for data on about 17 million commercial‑license holders.

For the Trump administration, the new legal opinion provides a broader statutory basis for DHS to obtain illegal‑resident information from a variety of state departments. For states, weighing billions of dollars in federal aid against retaining control over personal data could create a new policy and legal tug‑of‑war.

Because OLC opinions are binding on federal agencies but do not carry the force of a congressional law, it remains uncertain whether a state that refuses to comply will actually see TANF or SSI funds reduced, and whether such conditions would survive constitutional and federal‑law scrutiny, likely leaving the issue to the courts.

As the 2026 midterm elections approach, immigration policy has become a key political and legal battleground between the Trump administration and Democratic‑run states. If the reporting requirement is fully implemented, information exchanges between state departments and federal immigration‑enforcement officials would expand dramatically, potentially becoming the focus of the next wave of immigration‑policy litigation.

items.title: 「川普幣」真的來了！1美元可拿來花 創美國現任總統首例
items.title_en: The “Trump Coin” Is Real! $1 Can Be Spent, a First for a Sitting U.S. President
paras: 多家媒體週三 (2日) 報導，美國總統川普如今不只活躍地出現在白宮、新聞與社群平台上，也正式進入美國人的口袋。美國鑄幣局推出印有川普肖像的1美元硬幣，使他成為美國史上首位登上日常流通硬幣的現任總統。
美國鑄幣局正式推出印有川普肖像的1美元硬幣，這批硬幣已投入市場流通，收藏版卷裝及袋裝產品也同步開賣。
這款硬幣是為紀念美國建國250週年而發行，預計鑄造約900萬枚。雖然面額只有1美元，但收藏價顯然不只1美元：每卷25枚售價61美元，100枚袋裝版本則售154.50美元。
想在日常找零時收到「川普幣」，可能需要一些運氣。1美元硬幣在美國的使用率遠低於紙鈔，市場流通量相對有限，鑄幣局也鼓勵民眾多留意手中的零錢。
收藏家還可尋找特殊版本。美國鑄幣局7月4日鑄造了25萬枚帶有「July 4th」特殊標記的硬幣，並將其隨機放入一般卷裝及袋裝產品中。
硬幣外觀呈金色，但實際上並不含黃金，主要成分為88.5%銅，另含少量鋅、錳及鎳。這批硬幣在費城鑄造，沒有鑄幣標記。
硬幣正面由美國鑄幣局首席雕刻師Joseph Menna設計，圖像取自白宮官方照片，川普近乎正面直視前方，上方刻有「LIBERTY」、「IN GOD WE TRUST」及「1776-2026」。
背面則採用前首席雕刻師Frank Gasparro創作的美國總統徽章，並在老鷹盾牌上加入數字「250」，象徵美國獨立250週年。
柯立芝曾登上硬幣 但並非日常流通款
川普不是第一位任內出現在美國硬幣上的總統。1926年，美國慶祝獨立150週年時，時任總統柯立芝曾與首任總統華盛頓一同登上半美元硬幣，成為首位出現在美國硬幣上的在世總統。
不過，柯立芝版本屬於紀念幣，並非為日常交易而發行。川普版則是可以實際使用的法定貨幣，因此創下美國現任總統登上日常流通硬幣的首例。
可以拿來花 法律依據卻有爭議
川普1美元硬幣已成為法定貨幣，但其法律依據仍受到質疑。美國長期避免將在世人物 (活人) 肖像放上貨幣，這項傳統可追溯至18世紀末。當時鑄幣局曾希望把華盛頓肖像放上貨幣，但遭到本人拒絕，理由是這種做法過於接近君主制。
美國國會1866年通過修正案，禁止紙鈔採用在世人物的肖像；其他貨幣法規及長期慣例，也對在世人物登上硬幣設有限制。不過，美國貨幣圖案受到多項法律規範，適用範圍並不完全一致。
川普政府援引《2020年流通收藏硬幣重新設計法》作為發行依據。這項法律由川普第一任期內簽署，允許鑄幣局在2026年發行採用美國建國週年象徵設計的1美元硬幣。
財長貝森特則以柯立芝為例，主張美國在獨立150週年時既然曾讓現任總統登上硬幣，建國250週年推出川普硬幣也有先例可循。
研究美國貨幣的美國大學經濟學副教授Gabriel Mathy對此持不同看法。他認為這款硬幣可被視為違法，但美國相關法律在實務上更接近難以執行的規範。
硬幣的設計程序同樣引發批評。美國美術委員會曾建議採用川普側面肖像及另一款老鷹圖案，但兩項建議均未獲採納；通常負責審查鑄幣設計的公民鑄幣諮詢委員會，則拒絕審議這款硬幣。
paras_en: Multiple media outlets reported on Wednesday (the 2nd) that President Donald Trump is now not only active at the White House, in the news and on social platforms, but has also officially entered Americans' wallets. The U.S. Mint has launched a $1 coin bearing Trump’s portrait, making him the first sitting president in U.S. history to appear on everyday circulating coinage.
The U.S. Mint officially released the $1 coin with Trump’s portrait, and the batch has already entered circulation. Collector’s rolls and bagged products are also on sale simultaneously.

The coin was issued to commemorate the United States’ 250th anniversary, with an expected mintage of about 9 million. Although its face value is only $1, the collector’s value is clearly higher: a roll of 25 coins sells for $61, and a 100‑coin bag sells for $154.50.

Receiving a “Trump coin” as everyday change may require some luck. $1 coins are used far less frequently than paper bills in the United States, so their market circulation is relatively limited, and the Mint encourages people to pay attention to the change they have on hand.
Collectors can also look for special versions. On July 4 the Mint struck 250,000 coins with a “July 4th” special mark, which are randomly placed in the regular rolls and bags.
The coin looks gold‑colored but contains no gold; it is made of 88.5 % copper with small amounts of zinc, manganese and nickel. The batch was minted in Philadelphia and carries no mint mark.

The obverse was designed by Joseph Menna, the Mint’s chief engraver, using an official White House photo. Trump is shown almost straight‑on, looking forward, with the legends “LIBERTY,” “IN GOD WE TRUST” and “1776‑2026” inscribed above.
The reverse uses the presidential seal created by former chief engraver Frank Gasparro, adding the number “250” to the eagle’s shield to symbolize the nation’s 250th anniversary of independence.
Hoover once appeared on a coin, but not as a regular‑issue circulating piece.

Trump is not the first president to appear on a U.S. coin while in office. In 1926, during the 150th‑anniversary celebrations, sitting President Calvin Hoover appeared alongside the first president George Washington on a half‑dollar coin, becoming the first living president to be featured on U.S. coinage.

However, Hoover’s coin was a commemorative issue, not intended for everyday transactions. The Trump version is legal tender that can actually be spent, making it the first instance of a sitting president on a circulating coin.
Can Be Spent – Legal Basis Remains Controversial

The Trump $1 coin is legal tender, but its statutory basis is disputed. The United States has long avoided placing living persons’ likenesses on currency, a tradition dating back to the late 18th century when the Mint wanted to put Washington’s portrait on money but he refused, citing concerns about monarchical overtones.

Congress passed an amendment in 1866 prohibiting the use of living persons’ images on paper money; other currency statutes and long‑standing practices also limit living individuals on coins. Yet U.S. coin‑design regulations are governed by multiple laws with varying scopes.

The Trump administration cited the 2020 Circulating Collectible Coin Redesign Act as the authority for the issue. That law, signed during Trump’s first term, permits the Mint to issue a $1 coin in 2026 featuring designs that commemorate the nation’s founding anniversary.

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen pointed to Hoover as precedent, arguing that since a sitting president appeared on a coin for the 150th anniversary, issuing a Trump coin for the 250th has historical precedent.

Gabriel Mathy, an associate professor of economics at a U.S. university who studies American money, disagrees. He believes the coin may be illegal, but notes that the relevant statutes are practically unenforceable.

The design process also drew criticism. The U.S. Commission of Fine Arts had suggested using a profile portrait of Trump and an alternative eagle design, but both proposals were rejected; the Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee, which normally reviews coin designs, refused to consider this coin.

items.title: DeepSeek只是開始！中國AI「老虎」ETF登場 瞄準估值趨同機會
items.title_en: DeepSeek Is Just the Beginning! China’s AI "Tigers" ETF Debuts, Targeting Valuation Convergence Opportunities
paras: 中國挑戰美國人工智慧(AI)主導地位的競爭，正逐漸從私募市場延伸至公開股票市場，讓ETF投資人開始有機會直接押注中國新興AI基礎模型開發商。EMXETF近期推出China AI Tigers LLM ETF(TGRZ-US)，鎖定中國AI模型開發領域，而非像傳統中國科技ETF一樣廣泛布局半導體、雲端運算、電子商務及其他科技產業。
EMXETF創辦人Kevin Carter表示，這檔ETF推出的時機與中國AI模型企業接連上市密切相關。Z.ai及MiniMax均在2026年1月上市，使原本主要存在於私人市場的中國AI模型投資題材首次大規模進入公開市場。
Carter接受Benzinga訪問時表示，「時機的關鍵在於那些IPO——Z.ai和MiniMax均於2026年1月上市，這使得中國人工智慧模型板塊驟然具備了投資價值。」他指出，TGRZ的設計也考慮到未來可能上市的中國AI模型公司，包括DeepSeek及Moonshot AI。
其中，Moonshot AI的上市動向尤其受到市場關注。這家Kimi系列AI模型開發商據報正考慮在香港進行IPO，近期並已籌集超過20億美元資金。Reuters此前報導，Moonshot也已與微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)展開初步洽談，討論圍繞Kimi K3模型的潛在收入分成協議。
若DeepSeek、Moonshot等未上市AI模型公司未來進入公開市場，將進一步擴大中國AI模型企業可供全球投資人直接交易的範圍。對TGRZ而言，這類潛在新股正是ETF希望透過季度再平衡機制納入的標的。
Carter對「中國AI老虎」的定義相當明確。他認為，AI老虎應該是正在建立基礎AI模型的企業，而不是單純使用AI技術的公司，也不是提供晶片、雲端運算等更廣泛AI基礎設施的企業。
他指出，許多中國AI新創與清華大學存在密切關聯，而清華大學已成為中國重要AI研究及實驗室的人才與技術來源之一。例如Z.ai便源自清華研究體系；Moonshot AI創辦人楊植麟(Yang Zhilin)則曾在清華大學師從Z.ai聯合創辦人、清華大學教授唐傑(Tang Jie)。
Carter認為，市場可能仍然低估中國AI模型的實際進展。他表示，「最大的誤解是中國仍在追趕。」在他看來，部分中國AI模型目前已經接近甚至達到全球前沿水準，而且美國企業已經開始建立在這些中國模型之上並實際使用。
這項判斷也構成TGRZ背後最重要的投資論述之一。Carter認為，美中AI模型開發商之間存在巨大的估值差距，目前沒有一家中國AI模型開發商的估值超過1000億美元，但美國AI實驗室正在尋求遠高於此的估值，因此市場可能出現一項「估值趨同交易」。
Carter表示，「可以說，前方存在一種趨同交易機會。」他的核心觀點是，如果中國AI模型能力持續逼近全球前沿，而中國模型開發商的商業化速度及市場滲透率同步提升，中美AI企業之間巨大的估值落差可能逐步縮小。
不過，中國AI模型企業並不一定符合傳統意義上的「便宜」標準。以Z.ai為例，該公司2026年上半年營收達9.539億元人民幣(約1.419億美元)，較去年同期大增400%，但同期仍錄得20億元人民幣(約2.976億美元)淨虧損，研發支出更高達21億元人民幣(約3.124億美元)。
換言之，Z.ai雖然營收增速極快，但為維持AI模型研發及競爭力，公司仍需要投入龐大資金。這也反映中國AI模型產業目前的共同特徵，即營收高速成長與巨額研發支出並存，短期獲利能力仍然受到考驗。
另一家已上市的AI模型開發商MiniMax則在2026年1月於香港上市後受到投資人追捧，上市首日股價一度較發行價翻倍以上，收市時公司市值約137億美元。MiniMax的市場表現顯示，投資人對中國AI模型企業的成長潛力已經產生相當高的興趣。
TGRZ與傳統中國科技ETF的最大差異，在於其並不追求分散持有整個中國科技產業。該ETF的年度費用率為0.86%，投資策略是集中押注中國領先AI模型開發商。
Carter表示，「這不是一隻多元化中國科技基金，而是對中國領先AI模型開發公司的集中押注。」因此，TGRZ投資人承擔的並非整體中國科技股表現，而是中國AI模型產業能否持續突破、商業化及估值重估的集中風險。
這項策略也與中國目前發展AI的路線有關。DeepSeek在全球AI市場掀起的衝擊，已經證明前沿AI模型未必需要完全複製美國企業動輒數百億美元的資本支出模式。中國AI企業更加強調開源、可客製化及低成本模型，可能形成與美國大型AI企業不同的商業模式。
Carter認為，成本優勢可能成為中國AI模型擴大使用的重要武器。他表示，「中國正在採取不同的路線——開放、可客製化，而且成本大幅降低的AI，可以遠遠超出中國本土市場擴散。我認為兩種路線都有巨大的成長空間。」
這也意味著，中國AI產業的競爭優勢未必只來自模型能力，而可能同時來自價格。若中國企業能以較低的訓練及推理成本提供接近全球前沿水準的模型，將有機會推動AI應用從大型企業進一步擴展至更多中小企業及開發者。
不過，中國AI產業仍受到美國出口管制、先進晶片取得、算力基礎設施及地緣政治等因素影響。即使模型開發商能在演算法及成本控制方面取得突破，能否持續取得足夠算力，仍是影響其長期競爭力的重要變數。
TGRZ將採取季度再平衡機制，意味著基金未來可以隨著中國AI模型產業上市版圖擴大，調整持股組合並納入新的上市公司。對投資人而言，這項機制尤其重要，因為目前中國最受矚目的部分AI模型公司仍處於私人市場。
Carter明確表示，DeepSeek及Moonshot AI正是這檔ETF未來希望捕捉的上市標的。若這些企業最終完成IPO，投資人便不必再透過私募基金或風險投資渠道參與中國AI模型產業，而可以直接透過公開市場及ETF取得相關曝險。
從更大的產業格局來看，中國AI投資題材正在出現結構性轉變。過去投資中國AI通常需要透過晶片製造、雲端服務、伺服器、電子商務或大型科技企業間接參與；如今隨著Z.ai及MiniMax上市，AI基礎模型本身開始成為可以直接交易的資產類別。
TGRZ的推出因此不只是新增一檔中國科技ETF，更反映全球資本市場開始嘗試重新定價中國AI模型產業。若中國AI模型持續縮小與美國前沿模型的技術差距，而中國企業的估值仍大幅低於美國同業，Carter所稱的「估值趨同交易」確實可能成為未來市場關注的投資主題。
但另一方面，Z.ai巨額虧損、研發支出快速增加，以及中國AI產業高度依賴持續資本投入，也提醒投資人，技術突破並不必然等同於商業獲利。對TGRZ而言，未來真正的考驗將是這些AI模型開發商能否把快速增加的使用量及技術能力轉化為穩定營收與長期利潤。
隨著DeepSeek、Moonshot AI等潛在重量級玩家可能加入公開市場，中國AI模型產業的投資版圖正在快速成形。對全球投資人而言，這場AI競賽可能不再只是「美國模型對中國模型」的技術較量，也將逐漸演變成一場圍繞成本、商業化速度及估值差距的資本市場競賽。
paras_en: China’s challenge to U.S. AI dominance is gradually extending from the private market to the public equity market, giving ETF investors a chance to bet directly on emerging Chinese AI large‑language model developers. EMXETF recently launched the China AI Tigers LLM ETF (TGRZ‑US), focusing on the Chinese AI model development sector rather than broadly covering semiconductors, cloud computing, e‑commerce, and other tech industries like traditional China tech ETFs.

EMXETF founder Kevin Carter said the timing of this ETF launch is closely tied to the successive listings of Chinese AI model companies. Z.ai and MiniMax both went public in January 2026, bringing the previously private Chinese AI model investment theme into the public market on a large scale.

In an interview with Benzinga, Carter explained that the key timing was those IPOs—Z.ai and MiniMax both listed in January 2026—making the Chinese AI model sector suddenly attractive to investors. He noted that TGRZ’s design also considers future Chinese AI model companies that may go public, such as DeepSeek and Moonshot AI.

Moonshot AI’s listing prospects have drawn particular market attention. The Kimi‑series AI model developer reportedly plans an IPO in Hong Kong and has recently raised over $2 billion. Reuters previously reported that Moonshot has also begun preliminary talks with Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) about potential revenue‑share agreements around the Kimi K3 model.

If unlisted AI model companies like DeepSeek and Moonshot eventually enter the public market, the range of Chinese AI model firms available for global investors to trade directly will expand further. For TGRZ, these potential new stocks are exactly the targets the ETF aims to add through its quarterly rebalancing mechanism.

Carter’s definition of a "China AI tiger" is very clear. He believes an AI tiger should be a company building foundational AI models, not merely a firm using AI technology, nor one providing broader AI infrastructure such as chips or cloud computing.

He pointed out that many Chinese AI startups are closely linked to Tsinghua University, which has become one of China’s key AI research and laboratory talent and technology sources. For example, Z.ai originates from the Tsinghua research system; Moonshot AI founder Yang Zhilin previously studied under Z.ai co‑founder and Tsinghua professor Tang Jie.

Carter believes the market may still underestimate the actual progress of Chinese AI models. He said, "The biggest misconception is that China is still catching up." In his view, some Chinese AI models are already approaching or even reaching global frontier levels, and U.S. companies are already building on and using these Chinese models.

This judgment also forms one of the most important investment theses behind TGRZ. Carter argues that there is a huge valuation gap between U.S. and Chinese AI model developers; currently no Chinese AI model developer is valued above $100 billion, while U.S. AI labs are seeking valuations far higher, creating a potential "valuation convergence trade."

Carter said, "It can be said that there is a convergence trade opportunity ahead." His core view is that if Chinese AI model capabilities continue to close the gap with global frontiers, and if Chinese model developers’ commercialization speed and market penetration rise in tandem, the large valuation disparity between U.S. and Chinese AI firms may gradually shrink.

However, Chinese AI model companies may not necessarily meet the traditional notion of "cheap." Taking Z.ai as an example, the company’s revenue in the first half of 2026 reached 953.9 million yuan (about $141.9 million), a 400% increase year‑on‑year, but it still recorded a net loss of 2 billion yuan (about $297.6 million) and R&D spending of 2.1 billion yuan (about $312.4 million).

In other words, although Z.ai’s revenue growth is rapid, the company still needs to invest huge funds to maintain AI model R&D and competitiveness. This reflects a common feature of the Chinese AI model industry: rapid revenue growth coexists with massive R&D outlays, and short‑term profitability remains uncertain.

Another listed AI model developer, MiniMax, was well received by investors after its Hong Kong IPO in January 2026. On its first day of trading, the share price more than doubled the issue price, and the company’s market value closed at about $13.7 billion. MiniMax’s market performance shows that investors have a strong interest in the growth potential of Chinese AI model firms.

The biggest difference between TGRZ and traditional China tech ETFs is that it does not seek to diversify across the entire Chinese tech industry. The ETF’s annual expense ratio is 0.86%, and its investment strategy is to concentrate bets on leading Chinese AI model developers.

Carter said, "This is not a diversified China tech fund, but a concentrated bet on leading Chinese AI model developers." Therefore, TGRZ investors are not exposed to the overall performance of Chinese tech stocks, but to the concentrated risk of whether the Chinese AI model industry can continue to break through, commercialize, and be revalued.

This strategy also relates to China’s current AI development path. The impact of DeepSeek on the global AI market has shown that cutting‑edge AI models do not necessarily need to replicate the U.S. model of spending hundreds of billions of dollars in capital. Chinese AI firms emphasize open source, customization, and low‑cost models, potentially forming a business model different from large U.S. AI companies.

Carter believes cost advantage could become an important weapon for expanding the use of Chinese AI models. He said, "China is taking a different path—open, customizable, and significantly lower cost AI can far exceed domestic market diffusion. I believe both paths have huge growth potential."

This also means that China’s AI industry competitive advantage may not come solely from model capability, but also from price. If Chinese firms can offer near‑global frontier models at lower training and inference costs, they will have the opportunity to push AI applications beyond large enterprises to more SMEs and developers.

However, China’s AI industry is still affected by U.S. export controls, advanced chip acquisition, computing infrastructure, and geopolitical factors. Even if model developers achieve breakthroughs in algorithms and cost control, whether they can continue to secure sufficient computing power remains an important variable affecting long‑term competitiveness.

TGRZ will adopt a quarterly rebalancing mechanism, meaning the fund can adjust its holdings and add new listed companies as China’s AI model industry expands. For investors, this mechanism is especially important because many of China’s most watched AI model companies remain in the private market.

Carter made it clear that DeepSeek and Moonshot AI are the listings the ETF hopes to capture in the future. If these companies ultimately complete IPOs, investors will no longer need to participate in China’s AI model industry through private equity or venture capital channels, but can directly gain exposure through the public market and ETF.

From a larger industry perspective, the Chinese AI investment theme is undergoing a structural shift. In the past, investing in Chinese AI typically required indirect participation through chip manufacturing, cloud services, servers, e‑commerce, or large tech companies. Now, with Z.ai and MiniMax listed, the AI foundational models themselves have become a tradable asset class.

The launch of TGRZ is therefore not just a new China tech ETF, but also reflects global capital markets beginning to reprice the Chinese AI model industry. If Chinese AI models continue to close the technical gap with U.S. frontiers and Chinese firms remain vastly undervalued relative to U.S. peers, the "valuation convergence trade" Carter mentions could indeed become a future market focus.

On the other hand, Z.ai’s massive losses, rapidly increasing R&D spending, and the industry’s heavy reliance on continuous capital investment remind investors that technological breakthroughs do not necessarily translate into commercial profitability. For TGRZ, the real test will be whether these AI model developers can convert rapidly increasing usage and technical capability into stable revenue and long‑term profit.

As potential heavyweight players like DeepSeek and Moonshot AI may join the public market, the investment landscape of China’s AI model industry is rapidly taking shape. For global investors, this AI race may no longer be just a "U.S. model versus Chinese model" technical showdown, but will gradually evolve into a capital market competition around cost, commercialization speed, and valuation gaps.

items.title: 〈財報〉博通AI營收2027財年拚翻倍 盤後逆勢回升
items.title_en: Broadcom AI Revenue Targets Doubling in FY2027, After-Hours Stock Rebounds
paras: 晶片大廠博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)周三(2日)公布2026會計年度第三季財報，表現優於市場預期，雖然目前一季財測令人失望，盤後股價一度重挫5%，但隨後釋出對下一會計年度的樂觀展望，並強調與AI實驗室的業務往來正在增加，股價逆勢回升。
展望第四季，博通預期營收將達348億美元，但據LSEG數據，分析師原先預估為350.3億美元。
根據公司聲明，博通第三季營收較去年同期的159.5億美元大增86%。淨利則超過3倍至130.9億美元，或每股2.68美元。去年同期淨利為41.4億美元，或每股85美分。

Q3 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：295.9 億美元 v.s. 293.6 億美元
調整後EPS：3.32 美元 v.s. 3.24 美元


博通是AI熱潮的主要受惠者之一，為Google、Meta及OpenAI等公司設計客製化晶片。自2022年底以來，隨著ChatGPT及其他生成式AI服務興起，博通股價已飆升超過6倍，推動公司市值達約1.8兆美元。
不過，博通今年股價表現落後大盤指數。截至周三收盤，博通2026年以來上漲約6%，同期標普500指數上漲12%。
第三季期間，博通大力介紹與OpenAI共同開發的客製化Jalapeno晶片，蘋果則表示，將增加向博通採購美國製造晶片的支出。
執行長陳福陽(Hock Tan)在財報會議中表示，博通預期將加快向Anthropic出貨Google Ironwood張量處理器(TPU)，以及向Google出貨TPU 8i晶片。
他指出，未來幾年，博通每年將向Google交付數百億美元的處理器。
陳福陽談到，「Jalapeno對OpenAI的出貨將持續，至於Meta，我們預期將開始量產出貨其客製化MTIA加速器，該晶片針對大規模推理與推薦應用進行提升。」
根據陳福陽，博通預期Anthropic將在2027年部署5GW的TPU 8i晶片，並有望進一步交付另外10GW。而OpenAI正準備將第二代晶片設計送交晶圓廠製造，該AI實驗室也正與博通共同規劃第三代版本。
他表示，博通預期2027年Jalapeno的部署規模將達1.3GW，並有望進一步將Jalapeno及第二代晶片的部署規模擴大至超過5GW。
展望2027會計年度，陳福陽表示，公司目標是將AI營收翻倍至1,150億美元，並計劃在2028會計年度再翻倍至2,300億美元。他表示，公司EPS有望突破30美元。LSEG市場共識預期，博通2028會計年度調整後EPS為25.86美元。
博通財務長Amie Thuener表示，「我們正在協助兩家最具策略重要性的客戶，也就是領先的AI實驗室，填補目前現金流與其業務所需大筆前期投資之間的資金缺口。」
她指出，博通可能會向這些AI實驗室提供剩餘價值保證，這可能構成這些公司的或有負債(contingent liability)。
陳福陽表示，「對博通來說，投資並協助這些AI實驗室發展，在經濟上是合理的。」
第三季半導體業務營收較去年同期增加逾2倍，達167億美元，高於StreetAccount預估的152億美元平均值。博通表示，基礎設施軟體營收為87.5億美元，略低於分析師透過StreetAccount調查所得的88.2億美元市場共識。
paras_en: Chip giant Broadcom (AVGO-US) on Wednesday (the 2nd) released its third‑quarter FY2026 earnings, beating market expectations. Although the first‑quarter outlook disappointed and the stock fell as much as 5% after hours, the company later issued an optimistic outlook for the next fiscal year and highlighted growing business with AI labs, prompting the share price to rebound against the trend.
For the fourth quarter, Broadcom expects revenue of $34.8 billion, versus LSEG analysts' prior estimate of $35.03 billion.

According to the company, third‑quarter revenue jumped 86% year‑over‑year to $15.95 billion. Net income more than tripled to $13.09 billion, or $2.68 per share, compared with $4.14 billion, or $0.85 per share, a year earlier.

Q3 key figures vs. LSEG estimates: Revenue: $29.59 billion vs. $29.36 billion; Adjusted EPS: $3.32 vs. $3.24. Broadcom is a major beneficiary of the AI boom, designing custom chips for Google, Meta and OpenAI. Since the end of 2022, as ChatGPT and other generative‑AI services have taken off, Broadcom’s share price has surged more than six‑fold, lifting its market value to roughly $1.8 trillion.

However, Broadcom’s stock performance this year has lagged the broader market. As of Wednesday’s close, Broadcom is up about 6% since FY2026 began, versus a 12% gain for the S&P 500 over the same period.
During the quarter, Broadcom heavily promoted its custom Jalapeño chip co‑developed with OpenAI, while Apple said it will increase its spend on U.S.-made chips sourced from Broadcom.
CEO Hock Tan said at the earnings call that Broadcom expects to accelerate shipments of Google’s Ironwood tensor processing units (TPUs) to Anthropic and to ship the TPU 8i chip to Google.
He noted that in the coming years Broadcom will deliver tens of billions of dollars worth of processors to Google each year.

Tan added, “Jalapeño shipments to OpenAI will continue, and for Meta we expect to start volume production of its custom MTIA accelerator, which is optimized for large‑scale inference and recommendation workloads.”

According to Tan, Anthropic is slated to deploy 5 GW of TPU 8i chips in 2027, with the potential to add another 10 GW, while OpenAI is preparing to send its second‑generation chip design to a foundry and is co‑planning a third‑generation version with Broadcom.
He said Broadcom expects Jalapeño deployment to reach 1.3 GW in 2027, with the possibility of expanding Jalapeño and second‑generation chip deployments to over 5 GW.

Looking ahead to FY2027, Tan said the company aims to double AI revenue to $115 billion and plans to double it again to $230 billion in FY2028, with EPS potentially breaking $30. LSEG consensus expects adjusted EPS of $25.86 for FY2028.

Chief Financial Officer Amie Thuener said, “We are helping two of our most strategically important customers – leading AI labs – bridge the funding gap between their cash flow needs and the large upfront investments their businesses require.”
She added that Broadcom may provide these AI labs with residual value guarantees, which could constitute contingent liabilities for the companies.
Tan stated, “For Broadcom, investing in and supporting these AI labs makes economic sense.”

Semiconductor revenue in the third quarter more than doubled year‑over‑year to $16.7 billion, beating StreetAccount’s average estimate of $15.2 billion. Broadcom said infrastructure software revenue was $8.75 billion, slightly below the StreetAccount consensus of $8.82 billion.

items.title: 蘋果摺疊iPhone商機上看140億美元 大摩：iPhone X後最大變革
items.title_en: Apple’s Folding iPhone Could Generate $14 Billion Revenue, Morgan Stanley Says It’s the Biggest Change Since iPhone X
paras: 多家外媒報導，摩根士丹利 (大摩) 指出，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 首款摺疊iPhone可望為12月止季度貢獻約140億美元營收，下週的新品發表會也將成為iPhone X問世以來，蘋果最具關鍵意義的一場發表會。
摩根士丹利分析師Erik Woodring表示，這款新機將是iPhone自iPhone X以來最大幅度的外型改變。該行預期，新機上市初期需求強勁，但供應可能受限，2026年下半年產量估計介於700萬至800萬支，首個產品周期則可望達到2,000萬支。
這款摺疊iPhone也將成為蘋果定價能力的重要考驗。摩根士丹利預估，蘋果此次可能推出多年來幅度最大的同款iPhone漲價措施。
Woodring指出，NAND快閃記憶體與DRAM價格上漲，可能使iPhone Pro系列售價較去年提高逾200美元。iPhone 18 Pro的主要升級，預料是採用台積電 (TSM-US) 2奈米製程，以提高裝置端AI運算效能。
摩根士丹利認為，蘋果目前更擔心的是能否取得足夠零組件，而非市場是否有足夠買家，但記憶體供應仍可能限制短期產量。
Woodring表示，這場發表會「絕不平凡」。除了蘋果將推出市場期待已久、名稱可能為「iPhone Fold」或「iPhone Ultra」的摺疊新機，也可能同步宣布公司史上範圍最廣、幅度最大的同款iPhone漲價措施。
另一項重大變化是，這將是15年來首場不由庫克擔任主講人的蘋果發表會。新任執行長特納斯將接棒主持，帶領蘋果發表近10年來變化最大的iPhone外型設計。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週三 (2日) 開高走低，早盤以 326.86 美元開出，一度升至 328.40 美元，但隨後賣壓出籠，最低下探 323.53 美元，終場下跌 0.46 美元或 0.14%，收每股 324.50 美元。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported that Morgan Stanley (MS) said Apple (AAPL-US) ’s first folding iPhone could contribute about $14 billion in revenue for the quarter ending December, and next week’s product launch will be the most consequential Apple event since the debut of the iPhone X.

Morgan Stanley analyst Erik Woodring said the new device will represent the most dramatic design shift for the iPhone since the iPhone X. The firm expects strong initial demand but limited supply, estimating production of 7‑8 million units in the second half of 2026, with the first product cycle potentially reaching 20 million units.
The folding iPhone will also be a key test of Apple’s pricing power. Morgan Stanley forecasts that Apple may implement the largest price increase for a single iPhone model in years.

Woodring noted that rising NAND flash and DRAM prices could push the iPhone Pro lineup’s price up by more than $200 compared with last year. The main upgrade for the iPhone 18 Pro is expected to be a 2‑nm process from TSMC (TSM-US) to boost on‑device AI performance.
Morgan Stanley believes Apple is more concerned about securing enough components than about market demand, though memory supply could still constrain short‑term output.

Woodring said the event will be “nothing short of extraordinary.” In addition to a long‑awaited folding iPhone—potentially called “iPhone Fold” or “iPhone Ultra”—Apple may also announce the broadest and steepest price hike for a single iPhone model in its history.

Another major change is that this will be the first Apple keynote in 15 years not led by Tim Cook. New CEO Ternus will take the podium, unveiling the most significant iPhone design change in nearly a decade.

Apple (AAPL-US) opened higher but fell on Wednesday the 2nd, starting at $326.86, briefly rising to $328.40 before selling pressure pushed it down to a low of $323.53, closing down $0.46 or 0.14% at $324.50 per share.

items.title: G20財長聯合聲明難產！美財長貝森特改發主席聲明：債務只能靠成長消化
items.title_en: G20 Finance Ministers’ Joint Statement Stalled! U.S. Treasury Secretary Blumenthal Issues a Separate Chairman’s Statement: Debt Can Only Be Managed Through Growth
paras: 美國財長貝森特在G20財金首長會議閉幕記者會上將「成長」兩字釘回議程中央，並稱「滿足於低於潛力成長的日子已經結束了。」
由於中國對全球失衡等措辭持異議，本次G20會議未能發出聯合公報，美國則以東道主身分發布《二十國集團主席聲明》聲明將增長列首位，並點名「自己造成的政策失敗」：監管與行政負擔過重、稅制不當、公私投資不足、內部市場割裂、勞動力技能缺口。
聲明中要求各國削減繁文縟節、提高勞動參與、降市場摩擦，並把AI定為通用技術，同時用AI增強網絡安全；金融素養、主權債務重組可預期性、穩定幣與跨境支付路線圖各佔一節。
貝森特也在X上把兩天會議的共識以一句概括道：「成長是持久繁榮最牢固底座，私人部門不是配角而是引擎。」
貝森特還提及荷姆茲海峽及全球航道自由通航，稱結束戰爭為永續成長必要條件。他並透露，海上封鎖持續，伊朗政權資金鏈正被切斷，「賣油所得換不成美元，資金鏈就斷」。
貝森特給伊朗經濟承壓時間是「數週到數月」，但強調不必崩盤，只要德黑蘭當局回談判桌，美國擬每星期實施一輪二級制裁。
貝森特在聲明中也單獨提及日本，並稱安倍經濟學是「革命性安排」，企業重組與規制壓減已見效，接下來輪到「高市經濟學」。
他自稱握有「市場沒有的資訊」，相信東京會出招促日元走強，但在被問到是否等於升息，則回答「市場已經在定價」。
對於向加拿大加徵關稅一事，貝森特則稱溝通管道暢通、討論AI與全球失衡及「把貿易局面重新拼回去」，美加非戰爭狀態，關稅讓步時間表並未在當場宣布。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Blumenthal, at the G20 finance leaders’ closing press conference, pinned the word "growth" back at the center of the agenda and declared that the era of being satisfied with growth below potential has ended.

Because China objected to terms such as "global imbalances," the G20 failed to issue a joint communique; instead, the United States, as host, released a "G20 Chair’s Statement" that placed growth at the top priority and singled out "policy failures of our own making": excessive regulatory and administrative burdens, an inappropriate tax system, insufficient public and private investment, fragmented domestic markets, and a skills gap in the workforce.

The statement called on all countries to cut red tape, raise labor participation, reduce market friction, and designate AI as a universal technology while using AI to enhance cybersecurity; it also allocated sections to financial literacy, sovereign debt restructuring predictability, stablecoins, and cross‑border payment roadmaps.
Blumenthal summed up the two‑day consensus on X with the line: "Growth is the firmest foundation for lasting prosperity; the private sector is not a supporting character but the engine."

He also mentioned the Strait of Hormuz and the freedom of global shipping lanes, stating that ending war is a prerequisite for sustainable growth. He revealed that maritime blockades persist, the Iranian regime’s funding chain is being cut, and "oil sales cannot be converted into dollars, and the funding chain will break."

Blumenthal said the pressure on Iran’s economy would last "weeks to months," but stressed that a collapse is unnecessary; if Tehran returns to the negotiating table, the U.S. plans to impose a round of secondary sanctions each week.

In the statement, he singled out Japan, calling Abe’s economics "a revolutionary arrangement," noting that corporate restructuring and regulatory easing have shown results, and that the next phase is "high‑market economics."

He claimed to possess "information the market does not have," believing Tokyo will act to strengthen the yen, but when asked if this equated to raising rates, he replied, "the market is already pricing it."

Regarding the new tariffs on Canada, Blumenthal said communication channels were open, discussions were underway on AI, global imbalances, and "re‑assembling the trade picture," that the U.S. and Canada are not at war, and that the timetable for tariff concessions was not announced on the spot.

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉美伊爆發7月以來最激烈交火 油價漲逾1% Brent逼近96美元
items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: US‑Iran Escalation Is the Fiercest Since July, Oil Prices Rise Over 1% as Brent Nears $96
paras: 國際油價週三(2日)在劇烈震盪中收高，布蘭特原油期貨上漲98美分或1%，報每桶95.63美元；美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨上漲79美分或0.9%，報每桶91.01美元。美國與伊朗戰事進入第7個月，雙方爆發自7月以來最激烈的一輪交火，美軍攻擊伊朗南部海岸目標，伊朗則向美軍在中東多處基地發動反擊，市場擔心戰火進一步衝擊荷姆茲海峽的石油運輸。
週三交易期間，布蘭特與WTI一度最多上漲約2美元，也曾由漲轉跌約1美元，顯示市場對中東戰事及實際供應量的反應極為敏感。兩大基準原油盤中高點均創7月24日以來最高。
能源經紀商Liquidity Energy董事Mark Schaefer指出，最新一輪攻擊代表雙方在經歷約1個月相對平靜後出現重大升級，美軍這次鎖定伊朗雷達及布雷能力，伊朗則對美軍在區域內的據點發動報復。他表示，油市目前最關鍵的問題，是戰事重新升級是否會造成區域實體石油流量進一步惡化。
這場戰爭始於2月底美國與以色列聯合攻擊伊朗目標，此後伊朗實際上已大幅限制通過荷姆茲海峽的航運。荷姆茲海峽是全球最重要的能源運輸通道之一，戰爭爆發前約有全球1/5的石油及液化天然氣消費量經由這條水道運輸。
最新航運數據顯示，荷姆茲海峽的船舶通行量仍遠低於正常水準。Kpler初步數據顯示，週二僅有4艘大宗商品船通過荷姆茲海峽，低於前一天的10艘，也遠低於約13艘的10日平均值；通過船隻包括1艘超大型原油運輸船、1艘Panamax型油輪、1艘Kamsarmax型散裝貨船及1艘中型油輪，其中1艘進入、3艘離開。
荷姆茲海峽航運量下降，加上區域安全風險升高，使市場重新聚焦實際石油供應是否可能受到更大程度干擾。伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊表示，美軍最新攻擊將進一步限制荷姆茲海峽通行。
伊朗方面週三還表示，有2艘油輪在試圖通過荷姆茲海峽時撞上水雷並失去航行能力。伊朗政府網站同時顯示，當局又增加一批被認定為不遵守規定的船舶，若這些船隻試圖通過荷姆茲海峽，可能面臨罰款、扣押或拘留。
不過，美國能源部長Chris Wright週二表示，週一仍有1700萬桶原油通過荷姆茲海峽，創美伊戰爭爆發以來最高紀錄。這項數據顯示，儘管航運船舶數量明顯下降，部分大型油輪仍可能在特定時段維持較高運輸量，因此實際供應中斷程度仍存在高度不確定性。
供應端也正在尋找替代路徑。伊拉克8月提高原油出口量，9月出口量預計進一步增加。業界人士及航運數據顯示，較高的出口利潤，以及伊朗允許伊拉克油輪通過荷姆茲海峽，是推動買家增加採購的重要因素。
BOK Financial高級交易副總裁Dennis Kissler表示，衝突升級短期內將減慢荷姆茲海峽的通行速度，但市場已經逐漸消化替代性原油供應最終仍能進入市場的事實，因此油價雖然受到地緣政治風險支撐，漲幅仍受到其他供應來源的部分抵銷。
全球各國也持續透過尋找其他供應來源及動用戰略儲備，試圖限制油價進一步上漲。不過，部分國家的庫存已經明顯下降，使市場面對持續時間更長的供應衝擊時，緩衝能力受到考驗。
美國庫存數據則提供了另一項支撐油價的因素。美國能源資訊署(EIA)週三公布，截至上週商業原油庫存減少450萬桶至4.245億桶，降幅遠高於路透調查分析師預期的110萬桶，庫存水準目前約比5年平均高1%。
同期汽油庫存減少120萬桶，約比5年平均低6%；餾分油庫存則增加80萬桶，但仍比5年平均低14%。美國原油庫存意外大幅下降，加上中東供應風險升溫，使油市多空因素同時集中在供應端。
OPEC+也成為市場關注焦點。知情人士表示，OPEC+預計在週日(9月6日)舉行會議時，維持10月原油產量政策不變。產油國集團目前正完成一層產量減產措施的解除，並開始將注意力轉向2027年產量配額談判。
OPEC+此前自2023年開始實施每日165萬桶的減產措施，並逐步解除部分減產。不過，在美伊戰爭導致荷姆茲海峽供應受阻、俄烏戰爭持續影響能源設施的背景下，OPEC+調節市場供應的影響力已不如過去。
Reuters近期分析指出，OPEC+核心成員在全球石油產量中的占比已從戰爭前超過48%降至7月約40%，核心成員實際產量占比更只有約25%。荷姆茲海峽運輸受阻，使產油國即使提高產量，也不一定能有效補足市場實際缺口。
俄羅斯方面也出現新的供應疑慮。俄羅斯最新預測顯示，2026年原油產量可能降至約4.942億噸，折合每日約988萬桶，創2009年以來最低水準。俄烏戰爭、歐盟能源政策及烏克蘭對俄羅斯煉油設施的無人機攻擊，都對俄羅斯能源產業形成壓力。
另一方面，全球需求疲弱仍可能限制油價上漲空間。Reuters最新調查顯示，31名分析師預期2026年布蘭特原油平均價格約為85.08美元、WTI約80.20美元，與7月預測大致一致。分析師認為，中東供應風險將使油價維持在每桶80美元以上，但中國需求疲弱可能抑制進一步上漲。
中國原油需求已出現降溫跡象。Reuters指出，中國7月原油進口量較去年同期下降24.3%，同時國際能源署預估2026年全球石油需求將減少每日160萬桶。需求疲軟與供應受限形成拉鋸，也解釋了為何油價在地緣政治風險急劇升溫之際，仍未出現失控式飆升。
不過，若荷姆茲海峽長時間維持低通行量，市場供應壓力可能逐步累積。荷姆茲海峽在戰前承擔全球近20%的石油運輸量，一旦大型油輪持續避開水道，即使替代供應最終能夠進入市場，也可能因運輸距離增加、保險成本上升及船舶周轉效率下降而推高實際供應成本。
此外，週三中東衝突升級並非唯一能源供應風險。俄羅斯週三夜間對烏克蘭南部敖德薩地區能源基礎設施發動大規模飛彈及無人機攻擊，烏克蘭輸電系統營運商Ukrenergo表示，相關攻擊波及能源基礎設施。俄烏戰爭與美伊衝突同時牽動全球能源供應，進一步提高油市的不確定性。
在需求沒有同步大幅增加的情況下，油價能否持續突破每桶100美元，關鍵仍取決於荷姆茲海峽的實際運輸量以及美伊戰事是否進一步擴大。若航運受阻時間延長，市場可能逐步消耗現有庫存及替代供應能力；反之，若通行恢復，近期因地緣政治風險累積的油價溢價可能迅速回吐。
截至週三收盤，布蘭特原油仍較前一交易日上漲1%，WTI則上漲0.9%，顯示市場目前仍在「供應中斷風險」與「替代供應及需求疲弱」之間尋找平衡。隨著美伊戰爭進入第7個月，荷姆茲海峽能否維持最低限度的石油運輸，將繼續成為左右全球油價走勢的核心變數。
paras_en: International oil prices closed higher on Wednesday (2nd) amid sharp swings, with Brent crude futures up 98 cents or 1% to $95.63 a barrel and U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures up 79 cents or 0.9% to $91.01 a barrel. The U.S. and Iran have entered the seventh month of conflict, sparking the fiercest round of hostilities since July. U.S. forces struck targets on Iran’s southern coast, while Iran retaliated against U.S. bases across the Middle East, raising concerns that the fighting could further disrupt oil traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.

During Wednesday’s trading, Brent and WTI briefly spiked about $2 and then fell roughly $1, reflecting the market’s extreme sensitivity to Middle‑East tensions and actual supply levels. Both benchmark crudes reached highs not seen since July 24.

Liquidity Energy’s director Mark Schaefer said the latest round of attacks marks a major escalation after roughly a month of relative calm. The U.S. has targeted Iranian radar and BREA capabilities, while Iran has struck U.S. positions in the region. He noted that the key question for the oil market is whether renewed hostilities will further worsen physical oil flows in the area.

The war began at the end of February when the U.S. and Israel jointly attacked Iranian targets, after which Iran has largely restricted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The strait is one of the world’s most important energy transport corridors, carrying about one‑fifth of global oil and LNG consumption before the conflict.

Latest shipping data shows that traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains far below normal. Kpler preliminary data indicates that only four bulk commodity vessels passed the strait on Tuesday, down from ten the day before and well below the 10‑day average of about thirteen. The ships included one very large crude carrier, one Panamax tanker, one Kamsarmax bulk carrier and one medium tanker, with one entering and three exiting.

The decline in Strait of Hormuz traffic, coupled with heightened regional security risks, has refocused the market on whether physical oil supply could be further disrupted. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said the U.S. latest attack will further restrict passage through the strait.

Iran also reported on Wednesday that two tankers struck mines while attempting to transit the strait and lost propulsion. The Iranian government website added that authorities have added a batch of vessels deemed non‑compliant; those ships could face fines, seizure or detention if they try to pass the strait.

However, U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that 17 million barrels of oil still passed the strait on Monday, the highest since the U.S.–Iran war began. This data shows that despite the clear drop in vessel numbers, some large tankers may still maintain high throughput at times, leaving the degree of supply disruption highly uncertain.

Supply-side alternatives are also being sought. Iraq increased crude exports in August, with September expected to rise further. Industry insiders and shipping data point to higher export profits and Iran allowing Iraqi tankers through the strait as key drivers for buyers to increase purchases.

Dennis Kissler, senior trading VP at BOK Financial, said that a short‑term uptick in conflict will slow strait traffic, but the market has gradually absorbed the fact that alternative crude supplies will eventually reach the market. Thus, while geopolitical risk supports oil prices, gains are partially offset by other supply sources.

Countries worldwide continue to seek alternative supplies and draw on strategic reserves to curb further price rises. Yet some nations’ inventories have already fallen sharply, testing the market’s buffer against prolonged supply shocks.

U.S. inventory data provide another support for oil prices. The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) released on Wednesday that commercial crude inventories fell 4.5 million barrels to 424.5 million barrels, a decline far larger than the 1.1 million barrels analysts expected. Current inventory levels are about 1% above the five‑year average.

During the same period, gasoline inventories fell 1.2 million barrels, about 6% below the five‑year average, while distillate inventories rose 0.8 million barrels but remain 14% below the five‑year average. The unexpected sharp drop in U.S. crude inventories, combined with rising Middle‑East supply risks, has concentrated bullish and bearish factors on the supply side.

OPEC+ has also become a focal point. Insiders say OPEC+ plans to keep October crude output policy unchanged at the September 6 meeting. The group is finishing the removal of one layer of output cuts and shifting focus to 2027 quota negotiations.

OPEC+ has been implementing a daily 1.65 million barrel cut since 2023, gradually lifting some cuts. However, with the U.S.–Iran war blocking Hormuz supply and the ongoing Russia‑Ukraine war affecting energy infrastructure, OPEC+’s ability to regulate market supply has weakened.

Reuters analysis recently noted that OPEC+ core members now account for just about 40% of global oil output, down from over 48% pre‑war, and their actual production share is only about 25%. Hormuz disruptions mean that even if producers raise output, it may not effectively fill the market gap.

Russia faces new supply concerns. Its latest forecast shows 2026 crude output could drop to about 494.2 million tonnes, roughly 9.88 million barrels per day, the lowest since 2009. The Russia‑Ukraine war, EU energy policy and Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian refineries are pressuring Russia’s energy sector.

Conversely, global demand weakness may still limit price upside. A Reuters survey of 31 analysts projected 2026 Brent at $85.08 and WTI at $80.20, roughly in line with July forecasts. Analysts believe Middle‑East supply risks will keep prices above $80 a barrel, but weak Chinese demand could curb further gains.

Chinese crude demand has shown cooling signs. Reuters reported that China’s July crude imports fell 24.3% year‑on‑year, while the International Energy Agency estimates global oil demand will decline by 1.6 million barrels per day in 2026. The tug of weak demand against constrained supply explains why oil prices have not surged uncontrollably amid rising geopolitical risk.

However, if the Strait of Hormuz remains at low throughput for an extended period, supply pressure could gradually accumulate. The strait handled nearly 20% of global oil transport pre‑war; if large tankers continue to avoid the channel, even eventual alternative supply may be hampered by longer routes, higher insurance costs and reduced vessel turnaround, driving up actual supply costs.

Moreover, the Wednesday escalation in the Middle East is not the sole energy supply risk. Russia launched large missile and drone attacks on Ukraine’s Odesa region at night, affecting energy infrastructure. The Ukraine power system operator Ukrenergo said the attacks impacted energy facilities. The Russia‑Ukraine war and U.S.–Iran conflict together heighten global energy supply uncertainty.

With demand not rising in tandem, whether oil can continue to break $100 a barrel hinges on actual Hormuz throughput and whether U.S.–Iran hostilities expand further. If shipping disruptions last longer, the market may gradually deplete existing inventories and alternative supply capacity; if traffic resumes, the risk premium built up from geopolitical tensions could quickly retreat.

At Wednesday’s close, Brent remained up 1% from the previous trading day, while WTI rose 0.9%, indicating the market is still balancing “supply disruption risk” against “alternative supply and weak demand.” As the U.S.–Iran war enters its seventh month, whether the Strait of Hormuz can maintain minimal oil traffic will continue to be the key variable shaping global oil price movements.

items.title: 〈台股盤前要聞〉外資轉空 4萬6築防線、 AI需求急催供應商擴產、大立光遭處置
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Pre-Market News: Foreign Investors Turn Bearish, Build 46,000 Defense Line, AI Demand Urges Suppliers to Expand Production, Largan Precision Faces Disposition
paras: 9/3台股盤前要聞
1.台股2日終場收最低46164.72點，下跌784點，跌破5日線，守住46000點大關，成交量9183.93億元；其中外資由買轉賣，賣超913.55億元，主要賣超00981A主動統一台股增長 5.1萬張，賣超聯電4.5萬張，並減碼台積電近1.2萬張。同時，外資也在台指期貨反手作空，淨空單大增6623口。
2.美國與伊朗軍事衝突再次升溫，推升國際油價走揚，市場避險情緒順勢帶動美元走強。台北股匯2日連袂走弱，在外資熱錢加速撤出下，新台幣兌美元一度摜破 31.8 元關卡，終場貶勢收斂，收在 31.728 元、貶值 9.5 分，為逾 1 周新低。台北及元太外匯市場總成交值放大至 37.48 億美元。
3.Google(GOOG-US)此次參與SEMICON記憶體高峰論壇，供應鏈基礎架構資深總監Nikhil Cherian指出，DRAM供給相當緊張，Google已開始把退役伺服器中的DDR4重新回收利用，讓DDR4整合進最新世代的AI伺服器中，更坦言即便這樣還是不夠，呼籲記憶體廠必須快速擴產。業界解讀，此舉不僅驗證DDR4及整體DRAM缺口非同小可，更可讓DDR4擁有更長的生命週期。
4.證交所及櫃買中心2日公告新增處置股，包括股價超過千金的光學股大立光(3008-TW)、散熱股雙鴻(3324-TW)以及光通訊股聯鈞(3450-TW)及前鼎(4908-TW)，處置時間從明(3)日起開始，除了聯鈞處置期至9月11日共7日之外，其餘3檔將關至9月9月，分盤交易均為2分鐘撮合一次。
5. AI需求持續高速成長，半導體供應鏈面臨前所未見的擴產壓力。台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)資深副總經理暨副共同營運長侯永清2日表示，AI需求不只是規模龐大，更大的挑戰在於需求變化速度遠超過去產業經驗，以台積電設備需求為例，去年底預估今年所需設備量若以1倍計算，僅一季後就提高至1.5倍，至今年7月更已達1.9倍，等同短短半年需求接近翻倍，整個半導體生態系都必須重新思考如何因應。
6.鴻海(2317-TW)董事長劉揚偉2日出席半導體展大師論壇表示，從系統整合商角度來看，這波AI產業需求不僅「快」，規模更是「非常、非常地龐大」，因此供應鏈業者都面臨擴產壓力，但同時也擔心未來這些擴充的產能是否能夠回收，這是許多供應鏈業者都有的共同顧慮。
外資反手賣超913億元大舉布空期貨 砍出00981A 5.1萬張、聯電4.5萬張
〈台幣〉熱錢撤出股匯雙殺 放量貶近1角收31.728元

〈SEMICON〉Google：TPU未來可能半年一代 量產模式還要再加速
paras_en: 9/3 Taiwan stock pre‑market news

1. The Taiwan index closed at a low of 46,164.72 points on the 2nd, down 784 points, breaking below the 5‑day moving average but holding above the 46,000 mark. Turnover was NT$9,183.93 billion. Foreign investors switched from buying to selling, net selling NT$913.55 billion, mainly selling 51,000 lots of 00981A (Unified Taiwan Stock Growth), 45,000 lots of United Microelectronics, and reducing holdings in TSMC by about 12,000 lots. At the same time, they also went short on Taiwan index futures, with net short positions jumping by 6,623 contracts.

2. Renewed military clashes between the United States and Iran have pushed up international oil prices, and the resulting risk‑off sentiment has strengthened the US dollar. On the 2nd, both the Taipei stock and foreign exchange markets weakened. With hot money pulling out rapidly, the New Taiwan dollar briefly fell past the NT$31.8 per US$ barrier, ending the session at NT$31.728, a depreciation of 9.5 cents and a weekly low. The total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets expanded to US$3.748 billion.

3. Google (GOOG‑US) participated in the SEMICON Memory Summit, where senior director of supply‑chain infrastructure Nikhil Cherian said DRAM supply is extremely tight. Google has begun recycling DDR4 from decommissioned servers and integrating it into its latest‑generation AI servers, but even that is insufficient, prompting a call for memory manufacturers to ramp up production quickly. Industry observers interpret this move as confirming that the DDR4 and overall DRAM shortage is serious and could extend DDR4’s service life.

4. The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced on the 2nd the addition of several stocks to the disposition list, including optical‑lens maker Largan Precision (3008‑TW) whose price exceeds NT$1,000, cooling‑solution firm Shuang Hong (3324‑TW), optical‑communication company Lian Jun (3450‑TW) and Qian Ding (4908‑TW). Disposition will start on the 3rd. Except for Lian Jun, which will be suspended until September 11 (seven days), the other three will be halted until September 9, with trading in each block occurring in 2‑minute intervals.

5. AI demand continues to grow at a breakneck pace, putting unprecedented expansion pressure on the semiconductor supply chain. TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) senior vice‑president and deputy COO Hou Yong‑qing said on the 2nd that AI demand is not only massive in scale but also changing far faster than past industry experience. Using TSMC’s equipment needs as an example, the equipment volume estimated at the end of last year for this year was 1×; after just one quarter it rose to 1.5×, and by July it had reached 1.9× – essentially a near‑doubling of demand within six months, forcing the whole semiconductor ecosystem to rethink its response.

6. Hon Hai (Foxconn) chairman Liu Yang‑wei said at the Semiconductor Masters Forum on the 2nd that from a system integrator’s perspective, the current AI industry demand is not only “fast” but “extremely, extremely large” in scale. Consequently, supply‑chain players face expansion pressure, but they also worry whether the added capacity can be recovered later – a common concern among many suppliers.
Foreign investors flipped to net selling of NT$913 billion and aggressively shorted futures, cutting 51,000 lots of 00981A and 45,000 lots of United Microelectronics.
Hot money outflow hit both stocks and forex, widening the NT$ depreciation to nearly 0.10, closing at NT$31.728.
Four soaring stocks including Largan Precision and Shuang Hong will be suspended from tomorrow; three will be disposed until 9/9 and Lian Jun until 9/11.
At SEMICON, Hou Yong‑qing said AI demand will double within six months, requiring a re‑structuring of supply‑chain cooperation.
At SEMICON, Liu Yang‑wei of Hon Hai said AI demand is both huge and fast, putting expansion pressure on suppliers.
At SEMICON, Ying‑Wai announced strong AI project launches, with capacity to increase by at least 50 % in Q2‑Q3 next year.
Major banks’ silicon‑photonic testing and positioning platform shipments are ramping up, with order visibility extending to Q2 next year.
Pegatron’s ‘T1 project’ AI server first batch ships for the autumn harvest; Tong Zixian said this AI wave has only just begun.
Taiwan‑US cooperation opens a new chapter; Gong Ming‑xin rushed to the US to “add” another US$20 billion, sparking another investment surge.
Google is even salvaging DDR4 for reuse and urgently urging DRAM makers to expand capacity; Nanya and Winbond stand to benefit.
At SEMICON, Google said TPU generations may arrive every six months and that the mass‑production model still needs to accelerate.

items.title: 聯鈞7月自結獲利1.48億元、年增279% 下半年擴產滿足客戶出貨
items.title_en: Lianjun Reports July Net Profit of NT$148 million, Up 279% YoY; Expands Production in H2 to Meet Customer Shipments
paras: 光通訊股聯鈞(3450)近日股價波動劇烈，遭主管機關要求公告財務資料，聯鈞自結公告上(7)月份單月稅後純益為1.48億元、年增高達279%，每股純益為1.02元。聯鈞今(2026)年第2季受惠光學產品占比持續攀升，單季EPS達2.09元，累計上半年EPS已達2.78元，已達去(2025)年獲利50％以上，前7月累計EPS為3.8元。
聯鈞股價近期也隨著業績轉佳，推升股價從7月底波段低點的338.5元，一路上漲至今日602元，波段漲幅逾7成以上。
聯鈞在法說上表示，儘管相關供應鏈已積極擴產，但AI光通訊供給量仍遠落後市場需求，預期未來幾年AI產品相關短缺情況仍持續延續，聯鈞也將持續加速擴產，以滿足客戶快速出貨的相關需求，公司董事會將陸續通過籌資案，擴大資本支出擴產。
法人表示，聯鈞近年受惠於AI帶動高速、寬頻傳輸需求快速提升，旗下COSA光學次模組產品涵蓋65G、100G至200G EML晶片，持續站穩全球委外COSA封裝領導地位，產能訂單以每年翻倍程度增長。
paras_en: Optical‑communication stock Lianjun (3450) saw extreme price volatility recently and was asked by regulators to disclose its financials. In its self‑reported figures, July’s net profit after tax was NT$148 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 279%, with earnings per share of NT$1.02. In the second quarter of 2026, the company benefited from a rising share of optical products, posting a quarterly EPS of NT$2.09 and a cumulative H1 EPS of NT$2.78, which already exceeds 50% of the profit level achieved in 2025. The cumulative EPS for the first seven months reached NT$3.80.
Lianjun’s share price has risen sharply alongside the improving performance, climbing from the low of NT$338.5 at the end of July to NT$602 today, a gain of more than 70% over the period.

The company said in its earnings briefing that although the related supply chain has been actively expanding, the supply of AI optical‑communication components still lags far behind market demand. It expects the shortage of AI‑related products to persist for several years and will continue to accelerate capacity expansion to meet customers’ rapid shipment needs. The board will sequentially approve fundraising plans to boost capital expenditures for the expansion.

Analysts note that Lianjun has recently benefited from AI‑driven growth in high‑speed, broadband transmission demand. Its COSA optical sub‑module products cover 65G, 100G to 200G EML chips, maintaining a leading position in global outsourced COSA packaging. Order volume for capacity is growing at roughly a doubling rate each year.

items.title: 友達出售新加坡廠處予威騰電子 交易金額87億元
items.title_en: AUO Sells Singapore Plant to Western Digital for 8.75 Billion NTD
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)今(2)日公告，將子公司AFPD位於新加坡的廠房及相關廠務附屬設施，出售給硬碟大廠威騰電子(Western Digital)，交易總金額為新加坡幣3.5億元(約新台幣 87.53億元)。
AFPD此次出售廠房的建物面積約17.7萬平方公尺(約5.35萬坪)，另有附屬設備一批，交易相對人為Western Digital (Singapore)，友達表示，處分目的為聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產及優化財務結構。
AFPD將提出OTP予買方簽署，並提供10個營業日的選擇權期間(Option Period)，過戶前提條件將視買方是否取得當地主管機關包括但不限於Jurong Town Corporation之核准，預計處分利益待買方取得核准後確認。
友達董事長彭双浪於最近一次法說中提到，公司持續聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產及優化財務結構，透過淘汰競爭力較低的低世代線，投資 AI 四支箭等新技術等高殖化應用。
paras_en: AUO (2409-TW) announced today that it will sell its subsidiary AFPD’s plant and related facilities in Singapore to Western Digital for a total transaction amount of SGD 350 million (approximately NTD 8.753 billion).

The AFPD plant covers about 177,000 square meters (approximately 53,500 ping) and includes a batch of ancillary equipment; the counterparty is Western Digital (Singapore). AUO stated that the disposal aims to focus on a light‑asset operating model, activate assets, and optimize its financial structure.

AFPD will issue an offer to purchase (OTP) for the buyer to sign and provide a 10‑business‑day option period. Transfer conditions will depend on whether the buyer obtains approval from local authorities, including but not limited to the Jurong Town Corporation; the disposal proceeds are expected to be confirmed once approval is obtained.

In a recent earnings call, AUO Chairman Peng Shuanglang reiterated the company’s continued focus on a light‑asset operating model, asset activation, and financial structure optimization, and on phasing out less competitive legacy lines while investing in high‑yield applications such as AI’s four‑arrow technologies.

items.title: 晶片不在美國生產就課稅！盧特尼克：台灣下周再宣布最高300億美元投資
items.title_en: Semiconductors Not Made in the U.S. Will Be Taxed! Lutnick: Taiwan to Announce Up to $30 Billion Investment Next Week
paras: 美國商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)周三(2日)表示，川普政府正考慮對進口半導體祭出新一輪關稅，並可能將課稅範圍擴大至搭載晶片的資料中心伺服器與消費性電子產品，藉此吸引更多晶片製造回流美國。
不過，新關稅預料將搭配赴美投資豁免機制，仿照川普政府對製藥業採取的模式。盧特尼克接受《CNBC》訪問時表示：「如果在美國生產，我們會提供關稅減免；如果不在美國生產，就得繳納關稅。」
川普今年1月已在美國商務部完成貿易調查後，對部分先進半導體課徵25%關稅。新一輪措施可能進一步擴大涵蓋範圍，不僅針對晶片本身，也涵蓋含有晶片的進口產品。批評者警告，此舉可能推高在美國興建資料中心的成本，但盧特尼克認為，提供本土製造豁免可望降低相關衝擊。
盧特尼克表示，目前各企業承諾投入美國半導體製造的金額已達約1.2兆美元，其中包括台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)及美光(MU-US)等公司。部分投資來自今年稍早完成的美台貿易協議，台灣承諾提供約5,000億美元投資與信用保證，以支持美國高科技製造。
他並預告，台灣下周將再宣布一批新的對美投資承諾，規模約200億至300億美元。

加拿大臨時加碼要求導致談判破局

談及美加貿易協議破局，盧特尼克再次將責任歸咎於加拿大，聲稱加方純粹出於政治理由，在最後關頭讓談判告吹，導致雙方未能在期限前達成協議，以阻止美國對加拿大商品加徵50%關稅。
盧特尼克表示，就在談判期限屆滿前幾個小時，加拿大代表團突然加入一些「瘋狂構想」，其中包括針對中型與重型卡車提出額外要求，使原本接近完成的協議生變。
他回憶，當時曾直接詢問一名加拿大部長：「你們是真的想讓談判破局嗎？」對方回答：「我不能說。」盧特尼克據此認為，加拿大是基於政治考量刻意中止談判。
不過，盧特尼克也承認，美方可能同樣在最後一刻提出新的要求，因為川普先前曾表示，這聽起來確實像是他可能採取的做法。雙方目前仍各說各話，持續互相指責對方應為貿易協議告吹負責。
paras_en: U.S. Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick on Wednesday (Feb. 2) said the Trump administration is considering a new round of tariffs on imported semiconductors and may expand the scope to data‑center servers and consumer electronics that contain chips, in an effort to bring more chip manufacturing back to the United States.

However, the new tariffs are expected to be paired with a U.S. investment exemption mechanism, modeled after the Trump administration’s approach to the pharmaceutical industry. In a CNBC interview, Lutnick said, “If it’s made in the U.S., we’ll offer tariff relief; if it’s not made in the U.S., it will be taxed.”

Trump imposed a 25% tariff on certain advanced semiconductors in January after a trade review by the U.S. Commerce Department. The new measures could broaden the coverage to include not only the chips themselves but also imported products that contain chips. Critics warn that this could raise the cost of building data centers in the U.S., but Lutnick believes that providing domestic manufacturing exemptions can mitigate the impact.

Lutnick said that companies have already committed about $1.2 trillion to U.S. semiconductor manufacturing, including TSMC (2330‑TW) and Micron (MU‑US). Some of the investment comes from a U.S.–Taiwan trade agreement signed earlier this year, under which Taiwan pledged roughly $500 billion in investment and credit guarantees to support U.S. high‑tech manufacturing.
He also announced that Taiwan will announce another batch of U.S. investment commitments next week, in the range of $20 billion to $30 billion.

Canada’s last‑minute demands caused the trade talks to collapse. Lutnick again blamed Canada, claiming the country acted purely for political reasons and let the negotiations fail at the last moment, preventing an agreement before the deadline and stopping the U.S. from imposing a 50% tariff on Canadian goods.

Lutnick said that just hours before the deadline, the Canadian delegation suddenly introduced some “crazy ideas,” including additional demands on medium‑ and heavy‑truck imports, which derailed an almost‑completed agreement.

He recalled asking a Canadian minister directly, “Do you really want to let the negotiations collapse?” The minister replied, “I can’t say.” Lutnick concluded that Canada deliberately halted the talks for political reasons.

Nonetheless, Lutnick admitted that the U.S. may have also made new demands at the last minute, as Trump had previously indicated that such a move would be consistent with his approach. Both sides continue to blame each other for the collapse of the trade agreement.

items.title: 大立光、雙鴻等4檔飆股明起遭關禁閉 3檔處置至9/9、聯鈞至9/11
items.title_en: Largan Precision, Shuanghong and Three Other Stocks Face Trading Suspensions Starting Tomorrow; Three Halted Until Sep 9, Lianjun Until Sep 11
paras: 證交所及櫃買中心今(2)日公告新增處置股，包括股價超過千金的光學股大立光(3008-TW)、散熱股雙鴻(3324-TW)以及光通訊股聯鈞(3450-TW)及前鼎(4908-TW)，處置時間從明(3)日起開始，除了聯鈞處置期至9月11日共7日之外，其餘3檔將關至9月9月，分盤交易均為2分鐘撮合一次。
處置原因部分，大立光為最近6個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達32.45%，且6個營業日起迄2個營業日收盤價價差達1,520元。最近90個營業日起迄2個營業日之收盤價漲幅達200.24%。
聯鈞處置原因為9月2日之本益比為122.11，且股價淨值比為15.7。另當日周轉率為7.56%，暨美商高盛證券商成交買進金額達新台幣1億元以上，且占當日該有價證券總成交金額比率為11.89%。單一投資人當日買進該有價證券之成交金額占當日該有價證券總成交金額比率10%以上，且達新台幣1億元以上。
雙鴻為最近6個營業日累積之最後成交價漲幅達31.08%，且當日周轉率達11.82%。
前鼎最近6個營業日累積之最後成交價漲幅達31.68%，且當日之成交量較最近60個營業日日平均成交量放大6.6倍，且當日周轉率達22.44%。
大立光近期股價持續狂飆，今日在外資由賣轉買助攻下大漲3.03％，昨(1)日盤中更一度衝上7,995元寫新天價。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced today (the 2nd) the addition of four stocks to the special handling list: optical giant Largan Precision (3008‑TW), cooling specialist Shuanghong (3324‑TW), optical‑communication firm Lianjun (3450‑TW) and QianDing (4908‑TW). The handling period begins tomorrow (the 3rd). Except for Lianjun, which will be restricted for seven days until September 11, the other three will be suspended until September 9, with each trading session limited to a 2‑minute matching interval.

The reason for Largan Precision’s handling is that over the past six trading days its closing price rose cumulatively by 32.45%, and the price difference between the closing price six days ago and two days ago reached NT$1,520. Over the past 90 trading days, the cumulative closing‑price increase over the last two days was 200.24%.

Lianjun is being handled because its price‑to‑earnings ratio on September 2 was 122.11 and its price‑to‑book ratio was 15.7. That day its turnover rate was 7.56%, and Goldman Sachs (U.S.) bought more than NT$100 million of the stock, accounting for 11.89% of the total value‑traded securities that day. A single investor’s purchases also exceeded NT$100 million and represented over 10% of the day’s total securities turnover.
Shuanghong’s cumulative price increase over the past six trading days reached 31.08% based on the last transaction price, and its turnover rate on the day was 11.82%.

QianDing’s cumulative price increase over the past six trading days reached 31.68% based on the last transaction price, and its trading volume that day was 6.6 times the average volume of the previous 60 trading days, with a turnover rate of 22.44%.

Largan Precision’s stock has been soaring recently; today it jumped 3.03% aided by foreign investors switching from selling to buying. Yesterday (the 1st) it even surged to NT$7,995 intraday, setting a new all‑time high.

items.title: AOI設備廠牧德8月營收3.61億元續創新高年增35.68%
items.title_en: AOI Equipment Maker Mude Technology's August Revenue Hits NT$361 Million, Continuing Record High with 35.68% YoY Growth
paras: AOI設備廠牧德科技(3563-TW)今(2)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收3.61億元，續創新高，月增約0.42 %、年增約 35.68 %，累計2026年1-8月營收26.31億元，年增14.39%。牧德指出，公司營運動能穩定成長中 ，部分高階產品接單已延伸至未來數季。
牧德表示，隨 AI 基礎建設持續擴大，電子產品朝高效能、高密度及高階化發展，帶動相關製程對精密檢測設備需求提升。牧德持續聚焦高階應用市場，未來產品布局以AI 伺服器 GPU 應用、光模組 MSA 、高階載板及先進封裝為主要發展方向，透過檢測技術與產品持續升級，掌握 AI 產業鏈及高階電子製程所衍生的檢測需求。
牧德並指出，光模組 MSA 及高階載板相關應用，隨 AI 伺服器、高速交換器及高速 傳輸需求成長，對線路精度、微細化及產品可靠度要求持續提高，帶動 MSAP 及高階載板製程相關檢測需求。公司將持續強化相關檢測技術與產品開發，提升高階應用市場布局，並積極掌握新世代電子產品製程升級所帶來的市場機會。
牧德的整體接單能見度維持良好水準，部分高階產品接單已延伸至未來數季，市場需求也優於去年同期。隨 AI 伺服器 GPU 、光模組 MSA 、高階載板及先進封裝等應用同步持續發展，加上新產品陸續導入，相關市場需求可望逐步反映於公司營運動能發展。
AOI 設備廠牧德科技 2026 年第二季營收 10.47 億元，毛利率 60.41%，季減 0.17 個百分點，年減 3.82 個百分點，稅後純益 3.32 億元，季增 12.65%，年增 36.15%，每股純益 5.19 元，
牧德科技 2026 年上半年營收 19.11 億元，毛利率 60.49%，年減 3.79 個百分點，2026 年上半年稅後純益 6.27 億元，年增 14.5%，每股純益 9.8 元。
paras_en: Mude Technology (3563‑TW) announced today that its August 2026 revenue reached NT$3.61 billion, setting a new high. The month‑over‑month increase was about 0.42% and the year‑over‑year rise about 35.68%. Cumulative revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$26.31 billion, up 14.39% YoY. Mude said its operating momentum remains stable, with some high‑end product orders already extending into the coming quarters.

Mude noted that as AI infrastructure continues to expand, electronic products are moving toward higher performance, higher density and more advanced designs, driving greater demand for precision inspection equipment in related processes. The company will keep focusing on the high‑end application market, with future product roadmaps centered on AI server GPU applications, optical module MSA, advanced substrates and advanced packaging. By continuously upgrading inspection technologies and products, Mude aims to capture the testing needs generated by the AI supply chain and high‑end electronic processes.

Mude also pointed out that applications for optical‑module MSA and advanced substrates are growing alongside AI servers, high‑speed switches and high‑speed transmission requirements. This raises demands for line accuracy, miniaturization and product reliability, boosting testing needs for MSAP and advanced‑substrate processes. The company will keep strengthening related inspection technologies and product development, enhance its high‑end market positioning, and actively seize market opportunities created by next‑generation electronic product process upgrades.

Overall order visibility for Mude remains strong, with some high‑end product orders already extending into several future quarters, and market demand exceeding that of the same period last year. As AI‑server GPU, optical‑module MSA, advanced substrate and advanced packaging applications continue to develop, and new products are gradually introduced, related market demand is expected to be reflected progressively in the company’s operating momentum.

Mude Technology reported Q2 2026 revenue of NT$1.047 billion, a gross margin of 60.41% (down 0.17 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter, down 3.82 points YoY), net profit after tax of NT$332 million, up 12.65% quarter‑over‑quarter and 36.15% YoY, and earnings per share of NT$5.19.

For the first half of 2026, Mude posted revenue of NT$1.911 billion, a gross margin of 60.49% (down 3.79 points YoY), net profit after tax of NT$627 million, up 14.5% YoY, and earnings per share of NT$9.80.

items.title: 市場震盪避風港！遠銀Bankee首創「靈活存」 活存2.435%罕見超越定存
items.title_en: Safe Haven Amid Market Turbulence: Bankee Introduces First‑Ever "Flexible Deposit" with 2.435% Current‑Account Rate Exceeding Fixed Deposit
paras: 面對全球市場震盪，不少投資人選擇暫時退守現金，卻常陷於「定存怕綁死、活存利息低」的兩難。遠東商銀 Bankee 社群銀行推出業界首創的「靈活存」專案，打破市場既定印象，首度將「定存與活存款項納入同一套資金配置」，更祭出活存年利率 2.435% 反超定存利率的罕見優惠，宣告正式打響數位銀行資金搶奪戰。
傳統理財觀念中，資金流動性與高收益往往不可兼得。遠東商銀 Bankee 表示，觀察到許多持有觀望資金或備用金的客戶，普遍存在「想爭取高收益，又不願犧牲調度彈性」的痛點。「靈活存」專案即是從該痛點出發，透過新機制將收益與流動性整合，創造定存與活存相互加乘的效益。
本次專案最大亮點，在於顛覆市場常規的「逆向利率操作」。民眾只要以符合條件之新資金開立一年期、固定年利率 1.78% 的定存，即可同步取得定存本金 50% 的高利活存額度，享受高達 2.435% 的活存年利率。專案門檻極具親民度，單筆最低 1 萬元即可起存，最高可達 300 萬元且不限筆數，不論是小資族或高資產客群皆能彈性參與。
以投入 100 萬元資金為例，開立一年期「靈活存」後，除 100 萬元可享固定年利率 1.78% 的定存收益外，還能額外取得最高 50 萬元的 2.435% 高利活存額度。最特別的是，該筆高利活存額度「不需一次存滿」，客戶可先鎖定高利率額度，再依據自身資金調度需求隨時存入或提領。
遠東商銀 Bankee 社群銀行強調，理財工具應隨市場環境與人生階段動態調整。在市場變動加劇的時代，資金主導權應回歸消費者身上。「靈活存」將單一利率選擇轉化為高彈性的資金調度工具，讓民眾在等待下一個最佳投資時機前，既能賺取高於一般定存的收益，又能保有「隨時拔槍進場」的機動性，實現資金效益最大化。
paras_en: Facing global market turbulence, many investors temporarily retreat to cash, yet often find themselves caught between the dilemma of "fixed deposits feel locked in" and "current accounts offer low interest." Bankee, a community bank of Far East Commercial Bank, has launched the industry’s first "Flexible Deposit" program, breaking the market’s conventional perception by incorporating both fixed and current deposits into a single funding strategy and offering a rare 2.435% annual rate on current deposits that surpasses the fixed deposit rate, officially launching a digital banking funding war.

In traditional financial thinking, liquidity and high returns are often seen as mutually exclusive. Bankee observed that many customers holding speculative or reserve funds generally face the pain point of wanting higher returns without sacrificing scheduling flexibility. The "Flexible Deposit" project addresses this pain point by integrating returns and liquidity through a new mechanism, creating a synergistic benefit between fixed and current deposits.

The highlight of this project lies in its reverse‑rate operation that overturns market norms. Customers who open a one‑year fixed deposit at a qualifying rate of 1.78% automatically receive a high‑interest current deposit credit equal to 50% of the fixed deposit principal, enjoying an annual rate of up to 2.435%. The program’s threshold is highly accessible: a minimum single deposit of 10,000 yuan is required, with a maximum of 3,000,000 yuan and no limit on the number of deposits, allowing both low‑income and high‑net‑worth customers to participate flexibly.

For example, with an investment of 1,000,000 yuan, opening a one‑year "Flexible Deposit" yields a fixed deposit return at 1.78% and an additional high‑interest current deposit credit of up to 500,000 yuan at 2.435%. The special feature of this high‑interest current deposit credit is that it does not need to be deposited in full at once; customers can lock in the high rate and then deposit or withdraw funds at any time according to their liquidity needs.

Bankee emphasizes that financial tools should dynamically adjust to market conditions and life stages. In an era of heightened market volatility, control of funds should return to consumers. "Flexible Deposit" transforms a single rate choice into a highly flexible funding tool, allowing people to earn returns higher than typical fixed deposits while retaining the ability to "jump in at any time," maximizing the efficiency of their capital before the next optimal investment opportunity arises.

items.title: 無懼大盤回檔！00406A除息逆勢吸金 掩護性買權策略發揮優勢
items.title_en: Undaunted by Market Pullback! 00406A Pays Dividend and Attracts Capital Against the Trend, Covered Call Strategy Shows Strength
paras: 中東地緣政治衝突再度升溫，受美股重挫拖累，台股今(2)日開低走低，終場大跌784點，收在46164.72點，跌幅1.67%，成交金額縮減至不到兆元。ETF 方面，市場交投熱絡，單日成交量突破20萬張的焦點包含群益臺灣加權正2(00685L-TW)與主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)。其中，00406A 逢除息首日，在大盤重挫之際展現強勁抗震力，吸引買盤逆勢低接，也顯見當市場波動度放大時，反而能為掩護性買權(Covered Call)策略創造出更高的權利金收益空間，吸引資金進場布局。
法人表示，隨著地緣政治風險升溫、美債殖利率攀高，以及美股回檔等因素影響，電子權值股遭獲利了結賣壓衝擊，台積電更失守2400元整數關卡，AI伺服器、高階PCB及記憶體等族群全面走弱。不過市場資金並未完全撤出，部分轉向受惠國際油價上漲的塑化、化工及能源概念股，使其成為今日盤面少數亮點。
主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)今(2)日除息，在大盤重挫之際仍吸引買盤低接，成交量維持高檔。投資專家表示，短線盤勢仍將處於震盪加劇階段，而投資組合若建立掩護性買權(Covered Call)部位，將有機會收取更高的權利金收入。尤其近期市場呈現高檔震盪、區間整理，甚至漲一天跌一天的格局，正是權利金策略相對有利的操作環境。
對於00406A這類透過權利金創造現金流的產品而言，近期盤勢反而具有正面助益。由於市場波動放大，有利於提升權利金收入來源。同時，市場普遍認為AI資本支出成長趨勢未變，即使短線出現如今日的大幅震盪，長期最受惠的仍是00406A所持有的核心科技股；而波動率上升同步提高權利金收益，也有助於強化整體收益表現。
主動中信台灣收益ETF經理人張書廷表示，後續仍可持續觀察SEMICON Taiwan展會效應、AI供應鏈接單狀況等。儘管大盤短期內可能維持震盪整理格局，但半導體、AI伺服器、先進封裝、電力與散熱，以及高速傳輸等長線主流趨勢並未改變。

paras_en: The Middle East geopolitical conflict heated up again, and dragged down by a sharp drop in U.S. stocks, Taiwan’s market opened lower and stayed lower today (the 2nd), ending the session down 784 points at 46,164.72, a decline of 1.67%, with turnover shrinking to less than a trillion TWD. In ETFs, trading was lively; the day's volume topped 200,000 contracts for the spotlight funds including Yuanta Taiwan Weighted Index Leveraged 2 (00685L‑TW) and the actively managed Chinatrust Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW). On its ex‑dividend day, 00406A showed strong resilience amid the market plunge, drawing buying interest at lower levels and illustrating that when market volatility expands, a covered‑call strategy can generate higher premium income, attracting capital to position itself.

Institutions said that rising geopolitical risk, climbing U.S. Treasury yields and the pullback in U.S. equities have pressured profit‑taking sales in heavyweight electronics stocks, with TSMC slipping below the NT$2,400 round number and AI server, high‑end PCB and memory groups all weakening. However, market money has not fully fledged; some has shifted to plastic, chemical and energy concepts that benefit from higher international oil prices, making them today’s few bright spots on the board.

The actively managed Chinatrust Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW) paid its dividend today (the 2nd) and still attracted buying at lower levels despite the market’s sharp decline, keeping volume at a high level. Investment experts say short‑term market action will remain in a heightened‑volatility phase, and portfolios that add a covered‑call position can capture higher premium income. Especially as the market now oscillates at higher levels, consolidates in a range, and even shows a pattern of up‑one‑day‑down‑the‑next, conditions are relatively favorable for premium‑generating strategies.

For products like 00406A that generate cash flow through option premiums, the recent market environment actually provides a positive boost. Amplified volatility helps raise premium income sources. At the same time, the market broadly believes the growth trend in AI capital expenditures remains intact; even though short‑term turbulence like today’s large swings occurs, the long‑term beneficiaries remain the core tech stocks held by 00406A. Higher volatility also lifts premium yields, strengthening overall return performance.

ETF manager Zhang Shuting of the actively managed Chinatrust Taiwan Yield said that future observation will continue on the SEMICON Taiwan exhibition effect, AI supply‑chain order flow, and other factors. Although the broader market may stay in a short‑term consolidation‑oscillation pattern, long‑term mainstream trends such as semiconductors, AI servers, advanced packaging, power and cooling, and high‑speed transmission remain unchanged.
