items.title: 「川普幣」真的來了！1美元可拿來花 創美國現任總統首例
items.title_en: The “Trump Coin” Is Real! $1 Can Be Spent, a First for a Sitting U.S. President
paras: 多家媒體週三 (2日) 報導，美國總統川普如今不只活躍地出現在白宮、新聞與社群平台上，也正式進入美國人的口袋。美國鑄幣局推出印有川普肖像的1美元硬幣，使他成為美國史上首位登上日常流通硬幣的現任總統。
美國鑄幣局正式推出印有川普肖像的1美元硬幣，這批硬幣已投入市場流通，收藏版卷裝及袋裝產品也同步開賣。
這款硬幣是為紀念美國建國250週年而發行，預計鑄造約900萬枚。雖然面額只有1美元，但收藏價顯然不只1美元：每卷25枚售價61美元，100枚袋裝版本則售154.50美元。
想在日常找零時收到「川普幣」，可能需要一些運氣。1美元硬幣在美國的使用率遠低於紙鈔，市場流通量相對有限，鑄幣局也鼓勵民眾多留意手中的零錢。
收藏家還可尋找特殊版本。美國鑄幣局7月4日鑄造了25萬枚帶有「July 4th」特殊標記的硬幣，並將其隨機放入一般卷裝及袋裝產品中。
硬幣外觀呈金色，但實際上並不含黃金，主要成分為88.5%銅，另含少量鋅、錳及鎳。這批硬幣在費城鑄造，沒有鑄幣標記。
硬幣正面由美國鑄幣局首席雕刻師Joseph Menna設計，圖像取自白宮官方照片，川普近乎正面直視前方，上方刻有「LIBERTY」、「IN GOD WE TRUST」及「1776-2026」。
背面則採用前首席雕刻師Frank Gasparro創作的美國總統徽章，並在老鷹盾牌上加入數字「250」，象徵美國獨立250週年。
柯立芝曾登上硬幣 但並非日常流通款
川普不是第一位任內出現在美國硬幣上的總統。1926年，美國慶祝獨立150週年時，時任總統柯立芝曾與首任總統華盛頓一同登上半美元硬幣，成為首位出現在美國硬幣上的在世總統。
不過，柯立芝版本屬於紀念幣，並非為日常交易而發行。川普版則是可以實際使用的法定貨幣，因此創下美國現任總統登上日常流通硬幣的首例。
可以拿來花 法律依據卻有爭議
川普1美元硬幣已成為法定貨幣，但其法律依據仍受到質疑。美國長期避免將在世人物 (活人) 肖像放上貨幣，這項傳統可追溯至18世紀末。當時鑄幣局曾希望把華盛頓肖像放上貨幣，但遭到本人拒絕，理由是這種做法過於接近君主制。
美國國會1866年通過修正案，禁止紙鈔採用在世人物的肖像；其他貨幣法規及長期慣例，也對在世人物登上硬幣設有限制。不過，美國貨幣圖案受到多項法律規範，適用範圍並不完全一致。
川普政府援引《2020年流通收藏硬幣重新設計法》作為發行依據。這項法律由川普第一任期內簽署，允許鑄幣局在2026年發行採用美國建國週年象徵設計的1美元硬幣。
財長貝森特則以柯立芝為例，主張美國在獨立150週年時既然曾讓現任總統登上硬幣，建國250週年推出川普硬幣也有先例可循。
研究美國貨幣的美國大學經濟學副教授Gabriel Mathy對此持不同看法。他認為這款硬幣可被視為違法，但美國相關法律在實務上更接近難以執行的規範。
硬幣的設計程序同樣引發批評。美國美術委員會曾建議採用川普側面肖像及另一款老鷹圖案，但兩項建議均未獲採納；通常負責審查鑄幣設計的公民鑄幣諮詢委員會，則拒絕審議這款硬幣。
paras_en: Multiple media outlets reported on Wednesday (the 2nd) that President Donald Trump is now not only active at the White House, in the news and on social platforms, but has also officially entered Americans' wallets. The U.S. Mint has launched a $1 coin bearing Trump’s portrait, making him the first sitting president in U.S. history to appear on everyday circulating coinage.
The U.S. Mint officially released the $1 coin with Trump’s portrait, and the batch has already entered circulation. Collector’s rolls and bagged products are also on sale simultaneously.

The coin was issued to commemorate the United States’ 250th anniversary, with an expected mintage of about 9 million. Although its face value is only $1, the collector’s value is clearly higher: a roll of 25 coins sells for $61, and a 100‑coin bag sells for $154.50.

Receiving a “Trump coin” as everyday change may require some luck. $1 coins are used far less frequently than paper bills in the United States, so their market circulation is relatively limited, and the Mint encourages people to pay attention to the change they have on hand.
Collectors can also look for special versions. On July 4 the Mint struck 250,000 coins with a “July 4th” special mark, which are randomly placed in the regular rolls and bags.
The coin looks gold‑colored but contains no gold; it is made of 88.5 % copper with small amounts of zinc, manganese and nickel. The batch was minted in Philadelphia and carries no mint mark.

The obverse was designed by Joseph Menna, the Mint’s chief engraver, using an official White House photo. Trump is shown almost straight‑on, looking forward, with the legends “LIBERTY,” “IN GOD WE TRUST” and “1776‑2026” inscribed above.
The reverse uses the presidential seal created by former chief engraver Frank Gasparro, adding the number “250” to the eagle’s shield to symbolize the nation’s 250th anniversary of independence.
Hoover once appeared on a coin, but not as a regular‑issue circulating piece.

Trump is not the first president to appear on a U.S. coin while in office. In 1926, during the 150th‑anniversary celebrations, sitting President Calvin Hoover appeared alongside the first president George Washington on a half‑dollar coin, becoming the first living president to be featured on U.S. coinage.

However, Hoover’s coin was a commemorative issue, not intended for everyday transactions. The Trump version is legal tender that can actually be spent, making it the first instance of a sitting president on a circulating coin.
Can Be Spent – Legal Basis Remains Controversial

The Trump $1 coin is legal tender, but its statutory basis is disputed. The United States has long avoided placing living persons’ likenesses on currency, a tradition dating back to the late 18th century when the Mint wanted to put Washington’s portrait on money but he refused, citing concerns about monarchical overtones.

Congress passed an amendment in 1866 prohibiting the use of living persons’ images on paper money; other currency statutes and long‑standing practices also limit living individuals on coins. Yet U.S. coin‑design regulations are governed by multiple laws with varying scopes.

The Trump administration cited the 2020 Circulating Collectible Coin Redesign Act as the authority for the issue. That law, signed during Trump’s first term, permits the Mint to issue a $1 coin in 2026 featuring designs that commemorate the nation’s founding anniversary.

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen pointed to Hoover as precedent, arguing that since a sitting president appeared on a coin for the 150th anniversary, issuing a Trump coin for the 250th has historical precedent.

Gabriel Mathy, an associate professor of economics at a U.S. university who studies American money, disagrees. He believes the coin may be illegal, but notes that the relevant statutes are practically unenforceable.

The design process also drew criticism. The U.S. Commission of Fine Arts had suggested using a profile portrait of Trump and an alternative eagle design, but both proposals were rejected; the Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee, which normally reviews coin designs, refused to consider this coin.

items.title: DeepSeek只是開始！中國AI「老虎」ETF登場 瞄準估值趨同機會
items.title_en: DeepSeek Is Just the Beginning! China’s AI "Tigers" ETF Debuts, Targeting Valuation Convergence Opportunities
paras: 中國挑戰美國人工智慧(AI)主導地位的競爭，正逐漸從私募市場延伸至公開股票市場，讓ETF投資人開始有機會直接押注中國新興AI基礎模型開發商。EMXETF近期推出China AI Tigers LLM ETF(TGRZ-US)，鎖定中國AI模型開發領域，而非像傳統中國科技ETF一樣廣泛布局半導體、雲端運算、電子商務及其他科技產業。
EMXETF創辦人Kevin Carter表示，這檔ETF推出的時機與中國AI模型企業接連上市密切相關。Z.ai及MiniMax均在2026年1月上市，使原本主要存在於私人市場的中國AI模型投資題材首次大規模進入公開市場。
Carter接受Benzinga訪問時表示，「時機的關鍵在於那些IPO——Z.ai和MiniMax均於2026年1月上市，這使得中國人工智慧模型板塊驟然具備了投資價值。」他指出，TGRZ的設計也考慮到未來可能上市的中國AI模型公司，包括DeepSeek及Moonshot AI。
其中，Moonshot AI的上市動向尤其受到市場關注。這家Kimi系列AI模型開發商據報正考慮在香港進行IPO，近期並已籌集超過20億美元資金。Reuters此前報導，Moonshot也已與微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)展開初步洽談，討論圍繞Kimi K3模型的潛在收入分成協議。
若DeepSeek、Moonshot等未上市AI模型公司未來進入公開市場，將進一步擴大中國AI模型企業可供全球投資人直接交易的範圍。對TGRZ而言，這類潛在新股正是ETF希望透過季度再平衡機制納入的標的。
Carter對「中國AI老虎」的定義相當明確。他認為，AI老虎應該是正在建立基礎AI模型的企業，而不是單純使用AI技術的公司，也不是提供晶片、雲端運算等更廣泛AI基礎設施的企業。
他指出，許多中國AI新創與清華大學存在密切關聯，而清華大學已成為中國重要AI研究及實驗室的人才與技術來源之一。例如Z.ai便源自清華研究體系；Moonshot AI創辦人楊植麟(Yang Zhilin)則曾在清華大學師從Z.ai聯合創辦人、清華大學教授唐傑(Tang Jie)。
Carter認為，市場可能仍然低估中國AI模型的實際進展。他表示，「最大的誤解是中國仍在追趕。」在他看來，部分中國AI模型目前已經接近甚至達到全球前沿水準，而且美國企業已經開始建立在這些中國模型之上並實際使用。
這項判斷也構成TGRZ背後最重要的投資論述之一。Carter認為，美中AI模型開發商之間存在巨大的估值差距，目前沒有一家中國AI模型開發商的估值超過1000億美元，但美國AI實驗室正在尋求遠高於此的估值，因此市場可能出現一項「估值趨同交易」。
Carter表示，「可以說，前方存在一種趨同交易機會。」他的核心觀點是，如果中國AI模型能力持續逼近全球前沿，而中國模型開發商的商業化速度及市場滲透率同步提升，中美AI企業之間巨大的估值落差可能逐步縮小。
不過，中國AI模型企業並不一定符合傳統意義上的「便宜」標準。以Z.ai為例，該公司2026年上半年營收達9.539億元人民幣(約1.419億美元)，較去年同期大增400%，但同期仍錄得20億元人民幣(約2.976億美元)淨虧損，研發支出更高達21億元人民幣(約3.124億美元)。
換言之，Z.ai雖然營收增速極快，但為維持AI模型研發及競爭力，公司仍需要投入龐大資金。這也反映中國AI模型產業目前的共同特徵，即營收高速成長與巨額研發支出並存，短期獲利能力仍然受到考驗。
另一家已上市的AI模型開發商MiniMax則在2026年1月於香港上市後受到投資人追捧，上市首日股價一度較發行價翻倍以上，收市時公司市值約137億美元。MiniMax的市場表現顯示，投資人對中國AI模型企業的成長潛力已經產生相當高的興趣。
TGRZ與傳統中國科技ETF的最大差異，在於其並不追求分散持有整個中國科技產業。該ETF的年度費用率為0.86%，投資策略是集中押注中國領先AI模型開發商。
Carter表示，「這不是一隻多元化中國科技基金，而是對中國領先AI模型開發公司的集中押注。」因此，TGRZ投資人承擔的並非整體中國科技股表現，而是中國AI模型產業能否持續突破、商業化及估值重估的集中風險。
這項策略也與中國目前發展AI的路線有關。DeepSeek在全球AI市場掀起的衝擊，已經證明前沿AI模型未必需要完全複製美國企業動輒數百億美元的資本支出模式。中國AI企業更加強調開源、可客製化及低成本模型，可能形成與美國大型AI企業不同的商業模式。
Carter認為，成本優勢可能成為中國AI模型擴大使用的重要武器。他表示，「中國正在採取不同的路線——開放、可客製化，而且成本大幅降低的AI，可以遠遠超出中國本土市場擴散。我認為兩種路線都有巨大的成長空間。」
這也意味著，中國AI產業的競爭優勢未必只來自模型能力，而可能同時來自價格。若中國企業能以較低的訓練及推理成本提供接近全球前沿水準的模型，將有機會推動AI應用從大型企業進一步擴展至更多中小企業及開發者。
不過，中國AI產業仍受到美國出口管制、先進晶片取得、算力基礎設施及地緣政治等因素影響。即使模型開發商能在演算法及成本控制方面取得突破，能否持續取得足夠算力，仍是影響其長期競爭力的重要變數。
TGRZ將採取季度再平衡機制，意味著基金未來可以隨著中國AI模型產業上市版圖擴大，調整持股組合並納入新的上市公司。對投資人而言，這項機制尤其重要，因為目前中國最受矚目的部分AI模型公司仍處於私人市場。
Carter明確表示，DeepSeek及Moonshot AI正是這檔ETF未來希望捕捉的上市標的。若這些企業最終完成IPO，投資人便不必再透過私募基金或風險投資渠道參與中國AI模型產業，而可以直接透過公開市場及ETF取得相關曝險。
從更大的產業格局來看，中國AI投資題材正在出現結構性轉變。過去投資中國AI通常需要透過晶片製造、雲端服務、伺服器、電子商務或大型科技企業間接參與；如今隨著Z.ai及MiniMax上市，AI基礎模型本身開始成為可以直接交易的資產類別。
TGRZ的推出因此不只是新增一檔中國科技ETF，更反映全球資本市場開始嘗試重新定價中國AI模型產業。若中國AI模型持續縮小與美國前沿模型的技術差距，而中國企業的估值仍大幅低於美國同業，Carter所稱的「估值趨同交易」確實可能成為未來市場關注的投資主題。
但另一方面，Z.ai巨額虧損、研發支出快速增加，以及中國AI產業高度依賴持續資本投入，也提醒投資人，技術突破並不必然等同於商業獲利。對TGRZ而言，未來真正的考驗將是這些AI模型開發商能否把快速增加的使用量及技術能力轉化為穩定營收與長期利潤。
隨著DeepSeek、Moonshot AI等潛在重量級玩家可能加入公開市場，中國AI模型產業的投資版圖正在快速成形。對全球投資人而言，這場AI競賽可能不再只是「美國模型對中國模型」的技術較量，也將逐漸演變成一場圍繞成本、商業化速度及估值差距的資本市場競賽。
paras_en: China’s challenge to U.S. AI dominance is gradually extending from the private market to the public equity market, giving ETF investors a chance to bet directly on emerging Chinese AI large‑language model developers. EMXETF recently launched the China AI Tigers LLM ETF (TGRZ‑US), focusing on the Chinese AI model development sector rather than broadly covering semiconductors, cloud computing, e‑commerce, and other tech industries like traditional China tech ETFs.

EMXETF founder Kevin Carter said the timing of this ETF launch is closely tied to the successive listings of Chinese AI model companies. Z.ai and MiniMax both went public in January 2026, bringing the previously private Chinese AI model investment theme into the public market on a large scale.

In an interview with Benzinga, Carter explained that the key timing was those IPOs—Z.ai and MiniMax both listed in January 2026—making the Chinese AI model sector suddenly attractive to investors. He noted that TGRZ’s design also considers future Chinese AI model companies that may go public, such as DeepSeek and Moonshot AI.

Moonshot AI’s listing prospects have drawn particular market attention. The Kimi‑series AI model developer reportedly plans an IPO in Hong Kong and has recently raised over $2 billion. Reuters previously reported that Moonshot has also begun preliminary talks with Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) about potential revenue‑share agreements around the Kimi K3 model.

If unlisted AI model companies like DeepSeek and Moonshot eventually enter the public market, the range of Chinese AI model firms available for global investors to trade directly will expand further. For TGRZ, these potential new stocks are exactly the targets the ETF aims to add through its quarterly rebalancing mechanism.

Carter’s definition of a "China AI tiger" is very clear. He believes an AI tiger should be a company building foundational AI models, not merely a firm using AI technology, nor one providing broader AI infrastructure such as chips or cloud computing.

He pointed out that many Chinese AI startups are closely linked to Tsinghua University, which has become one of China’s key AI research and laboratory talent and technology sources. For example, Z.ai originates from the Tsinghua research system; Moonshot AI founder Yang Zhilin previously studied under Z.ai co‑founder and Tsinghua professor Tang Jie.

Carter believes the market may still underestimate the actual progress of Chinese AI models. He said, "The biggest misconception is that China is still catching up." In his view, some Chinese AI models are already approaching or even reaching global frontier levels, and U.S. companies are already building on and using these Chinese models.

This judgment also forms one of the most important investment theses behind TGRZ. Carter argues that there is a huge valuation gap between U.S. and Chinese AI model developers; currently no Chinese AI model developer is valued above $100 billion, while U.S. AI labs are seeking valuations far higher, creating a potential "valuation convergence trade."

Carter said, "It can be said that there is a convergence trade opportunity ahead." His core view is that if Chinese AI model capabilities continue to close the gap with global frontiers, and if Chinese model developers’ commercialization speed and market penetration rise in tandem, the large valuation disparity between U.S. and Chinese AI firms may gradually shrink.

However, Chinese AI model companies may not necessarily meet the traditional notion of "cheap." Taking Z.ai as an example, the company’s revenue in the first half of 2026 reached 953.9 million yuan (about $141.9 million), a 400% increase year‑on‑year, but it still recorded a net loss of 2 billion yuan (about $297.6 million) and R&D spending of 2.1 billion yuan (about $312.4 million).

In other words, although Z.ai’s revenue growth is rapid, the company still needs to invest huge funds to maintain AI model R&D and competitiveness. This reflects a common feature of the Chinese AI model industry: rapid revenue growth coexists with massive R&D outlays, and short‑term profitability remains uncertain.

Another listed AI model developer, MiniMax, was well received by investors after its Hong Kong IPO in January 2026. On its first day of trading, the share price more than doubled the issue price, and the company’s market value closed at about $13.7 billion. MiniMax’s market performance shows that investors have a strong interest in the growth potential of Chinese AI model firms.

The biggest difference between TGRZ and traditional China tech ETFs is that it does not seek to diversify across the entire Chinese tech industry. The ETF’s annual expense ratio is 0.86%, and its investment strategy is to concentrate bets on leading Chinese AI model developers.

Carter said, "This is not a diversified China tech fund, but a concentrated bet on leading Chinese AI model developers." Therefore, TGRZ investors are not exposed to the overall performance of Chinese tech stocks, but to the concentrated risk of whether the Chinese AI model industry can continue to break through, commercialize, and be revalued.

This strategy also relates to China’s current AI development path. The impact of DeepSeek on the global AI market has shown that cutting‑edge AI models do not necessarily need to replicate the U.S. model of spending hundreds of billions of dollars in capital. Chinese AI firms emphasize open source, customization, and low‑cost models, potentially forming a business model different from large U.S. AI companies.

Carter believes cost advantage could become an important weapon for expanding the use of Chinese AI models. He said, "China is taking a different path—open, customizable, and significantly lower cost AI can far exceed domestic market diffusion. I believe both paths have huge growth potential."

This also means that China’s AI industry competitive advantage may not come solely from model capability, but also from price. If Chinese firms can offer near‑global frontier models at lower training and inference costs, they will have the opportunity to push AI applications beyond large enterprises to more SMEs and developers.

However, China’s AI industry is still affected by U.S. export controls, advanced chip acquisition, computing infrastructure, and geopolitical factors. Even if model developers achieve breakthroughs in algorithms and cost control, whether they can continue to secure sufficient computing power remains an important variable affecting long‑term competitiveness.

TGRZ will adopt a quarterly rebalancing mechanism, meaning the fund can adjust its holdings and add new listed companies as China’s AI model industry expands. For investors, this mechanism is especially important because many of China’s most watched AI model companies remain in the private market.

Carter made it clear that DeepSeek and Moonshot AI are the listings the ETF hopes to capture in the future. If these companies ultimately complete IPOs, investors will no longer need to participate in China’s AI model industry through private equity or venture capital channels, but can directly gain exposure through the public market and ETF.

From a larger industry perspective, the Chinese AI investment theme is undergoing a structural shift. In the past, investing in Chinese AI typically required indirect participation through chip manufacturing, cloud services, servers, e‑commerce, or large tech companies. Now, with Z.ai and MiniMax listed, the AI foundational models themselves have become a tradable asset class.

The launch of TGRZ is therefore not just a new China tech ETF, but also reflects global capital markets beginning to reprice the Chinese AI model industry. If Chinese AI models continue to close the technical gap with U.S. frontiers and Chinese firms remain vastly undervalued relative to U.S. peers, the "valuation convergence trade" Carter mentions could indeed become a future market focus.

On the other hand, Z.ai’s massive losses, rapidly increasing R&D spending, and the industry’s heavy reliance on continuous capital investment remind investors that technological breakthroughs do not necessarily translate into commercial profitability. For TGRZ, the real test will be whether these AI model developers can convert rapidly increasing usage and technical capability into stable revenue and long‑term profit.

As potential heavyweight players like DeepSeek and Moonshot AI may join the public market, the investment landscape of China’s AI model industry is rapidly taking shape. For global investors, this AI race may no longer be just a "U.S. model versus Chinese model" technical showdown, but will gradually evolve into a capital market competition around cost, commercialization speed, and valuation gaps.

items.title: 〈財報〉博通AI營收2027財年拚翻倍 盤後逆勢回升
items.title_en: Broadcom AI Revenue Targets Doubling in FY2027, After-Hours Stock Rebounds
paras: 晶片大廠博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)周三(2日)公布2026會計年度第三季財報，表現優於市場預期，雖然目前一季財測令人失望，盤後股價一度重挫5%，但隨後釋出對下一會計年度的樂觀展望，並強調與AI實驗室的業務往來正在增加，股價逆勢回升。
展望第四季，博通預期營收將達348億美元，但據LSEG數據，分析師原先預估為350.3億美元。
根據公司聲明，博通第三季營收較去年同期的159.5億美元大增86%。淨利則超過3倍至130.9億美元，或每股2.68美元。去年同期淨利為41.4億美元，或每股85美分。

Q3 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：295.9 億美元 v.s. 293.6 億美元
調整後EPS：3.32 美元 v.s. 3.24 美元


博通是AI熱潮的主要受惠者之一，為Google、Meta及OpenAI等公司設計客製化晶片。自2022年底以來，隨著ChatGPT及其他生成式AI服務興起，博通股價已飆升超過6倍，推動公司市值達約1.8兆美元。
不過，博通今年股價表現落後大盤指數。截至周三收盤，博通2026年以來上漲約6%，同期標普500指數上漲12%。
第三季期間，博通大力介紹與OpenAI共同開發的客製化Jalapeno晶片，蘋果則表示，將增加向博通採購美國製造晶片的支出。
執行長陳福陽(Hock Tan)在財報會議中表示，博通預期將加快向Anthropic出貨Google Ironwood張量處理器(TPU)，以及向Google出貨TPU 8i晶片。
他指出，未來幾年，博通每年將向Google交付數百億美元的處理器。
陳福陽談到，「Jalapeno對OpenAI的出貨將持續，至於Meta，我們預期將開始量產出貨其客製化MTIA加速器，該晶片針對大規模推理與推薦應用進行提升。」
根據陳福陽，博通預期Anthropic將在2027年部署5GW的TPU 8i晶片，並有望進一步交付另外10GW。而OpenAI正準備將第二代晶片設計送交晶圓廠製造，該AI實驗室也正與博通共同規劃第三代版本。
他表示，博通預期2027年Jalapeno的部署規模將達1.3GW，並有望進一步將Jalapeno及第二代晶片的部署規模擴大至超過5GW。
展望2027會計年度，陳福陽表示，公司目標是將AI營收翻倍至1,150億美元，並計劃在2028會計年度再翻倍至2,300億美元。他表示，公司EPS有望突破30美元。LSEG市場共識預期，博通2028會計年度調整後EPS為25.86美元。
博通財務長Amie Thuener表示，「我們正在協助兩家最具策略重要性的客戶，也就是領先的AI實驗室，填補目前現金流與其業務所需大筆前期投資之間的資金缺口。」
她指出，博通可能會向這些AI實驗室提供剩餘價值保證，這可能構成這些公司的或有負債(contingent liability)。
陳福陽表示，「對博通來說，投資並協助這些AI實驗室發展，在經濟上是合理的。」
第三季半導體業務營收較去年同期增加逾2倍，達167億美元，高於StreetAccount預估的152億美元平均值。博通表示，基礎設施軟體營收為87.5億美元，略低於分析師透過StreetAccount調查所得的88.2億美元市場共識。
paras_en: Chip giant Broadcom (AVGO-US) on Wednesday (the 2nd) released its third‑quarter FY2026 earnings, beating market expectations. Although the first‑quarter outlook disappointed and the stock fell as much as 5% after hours, the company later issued an optimistic outlook for the next fiscal year and highlighted growing business with AI labs, prompting the share price to rebound against the trend.
For the fourth quarter, Broadcom expects revenue of $34.8 billion, versus LSEG analysts' prior estimate of $35.03 billion.

According to the company, third‑quarter revenue jumped 86% year‑over‑year to $15.95 billion. Net income more than tripled to $13.09 billion, or $2.68 per share, compared with $4.14 billion, or $0.85 per share, a year earlier.

Q3 key figures vs. LSEG estimates: Revenue: $29.59 billion vs. $29.36 billion; Adjusted EPS: $3.32 vs. $3.24. Broadcom is a major beneficiary of the AI boom, designing custom chips for Google, Meta and OpenAI. Since the end of 2022, as ChatGPT and other generative‑AI services have taken off, Broadcom’s share price has surged more than six‑fold, lifting its market value to roughly $1.8 trillion.

However, Broadcom’s stock performance this year has lagged the broader market. As of Wednesday’s close, Broadcom is up about 6% since FY2026 began, versus a 12% gain for the S&P 500 over the same period.
During the quarter, Broadcom heavily promoted its custom Jalapeño chip co‑developed with OpenAI, while Apple said it will increase its spend on U.S.-made chips sourced from Broadcom.
CEO Hock Tan said at the earnings call that Broadcom expects to accelerate shipments of Google’s Ironwood tensor processing units (TPUs) to Anthropic and to ship the TPU 8i chip to Google.
He noted that in the coming years Broadcom will deliver tens of billions of dollars worth of processors to Google each year.

Tan added, “Jalapeño shipments to OpenAI will continue, and for Meta we expect to start volume production of its custom MTIA accelerator, which is optimized for large‑scale inference and recommendation workloads.”

According to Tan, Anthropic is slated to deploy 5 GW of TPU 8i chips in 2027, with the potential to add another 10 GW, while OpenAI is preparing to send its second‑generation chip design to a foundry and is co‑planning a third‑generation version with Broadcom.
He said Broadcom expects Jalapeño deployment to reach 1.3 GW in 2027, with the possibility of expanding Jalapeño and second‑generation chip deployments to over 5 GW.

Looking ahead to FY2027, Tan said the company aims to double AI revenue to $115 billion and plans to double it again to $230 billion in FY2028, with EPS potentially breaking $30. LSEG consensus expects adjusted EPS of $25.86 for FY2028.

Chief Financial Officer Amie Thuener said, “We are helping two of our most strategically important customers – leading AI labs – bridge the funding gap between their cash flow needs and the large upfront investments their businesses require.”
She added that Broadcom may provide these AI labs with residual value guarantees, which could constitute contingent liabilities for the companies.
Tan stated, “For Broadcom, investing in and supporting these AI labs makes economic sense.”

Semiconductor revenue in the third quarter more than doubled year‑over‑year to $16.7 billion, beating StreetAccount’s average estimate of $15.2 billion. Broadcom said infrastructure software revenue was $8.75 billion, slightly below the StreetAccount consensus of $8.82 billion.

items.title: 蘋果摺疊iPhone商機上看140億美元 大摩：iPhone X後最大變革
items.title_en: Apple’s Folding iPhone Could Generate $14 Billion Revenue, Morgan Stanley Says It’s the Biggest Change Since iPhone X
paras: 多家外媒報導，摩根士丹利 (大摩) 指出，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 首款摺疊iPhone可望為12月止季度貢獻約140億美元營收，下週的新品發表會也將成為iPhone X問世以來，蘋果最具關鍵意義的一場發表會。
摩根士丹利分析師Erik Woodring表示，這款新機將是iPhone自iPhone X以來最大幅度的外型改變。該行預期，新機上市初期需求強勁，但供應可能受限，2026年下半年產量估計介於700萬至800萬支，首個產品周期則可望達到2,000萬支。
這款摺疊iPhone也將成為蘋果定價能力的重要考驗。摩根士丹利預估，蘋果此次可能推出多年來幅度最大的同款iPhone漲價措施。
Woodring指出，NAND快閃記憶體與DRAM價格上漲，可能使iPhone Pro系列售價較去年提高逾200美元。iPhone 18 Pro的主要升級，預料是採用台積電 (TSM-US) 2奈米製程，以提高裝置端AI運算效能。
摩根士丹利認為，蘋果目前更擔心的是能否取得足夠零組件，而非市場是否有足夠買家，但記憶體供應仍可能限制短期產量。
Woodring表示，這場發表會「絕不平凡」。除了蘋果將推出市場期待已久、名稱可能為「iPhone Fold」或「iPhone Ultra」的摺疊新機，也可能同步宣布公司史上範圍最廣、幅度最大的同款iPhone漲價措施。
另一項重大變化是，這將是15年來首場不由庫克擔任主講人的蘋果發表會。新任執行長特納斯將接棒主持，帶領蘋果發表近10年來變化最大的iPhone外型設計。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週三 (2日) 開高走低，早盤以 326.86 美元開出，一度升至 328.40 美元，但隨後賣壓出籠，最低下探 323.53 美元，終場下跌 0.46 美元或 0.14%，收每股 324.50 美元。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported that Morgan Stanley (MS) said Apple (AAPL-US) ’s first folding iPhone could contribute about $14 billion in revenue for the quarter ending December, and next week’s product launch will be the most consequential Apple event since the debut of the iPhone X.

Morgan Stanley analyst Erik Woodring said the new device will represent the most dramatic design shift for the iPhone since the iPhone X. The firm expects strong initial demand but limited supply, estimating production of 7‑8 million units in the second half of 2026, with the first product cycle potentially reaching 20 million units.
The folding iPhone will also be a key test of Apple’s pricing power. Morgan Stanley forecasts that Apple may implement the largest price increase for a single iPhone model in years.

Woodring noted that rising NAND flash and DRAM prices could push the iPhone Pro lineup’s price up by more than $200 compared with last year. The main upgrade for the iPhone 18 Pro is expected to be a 2‑nm process from TSMC (TSM-US) to boost on‑device AI performance.
Morgan Stanley believes Apple is more concerned about securing enough components than about market demand, though memory supply could still constrain short‑term output.

Woodring said the event will be “nothing short of extraordinary.” In addition to a long‑awaited folding iPhone—potentially called “iPhone Fold” or “iPhone Ultra”—Apple may also announce the broadest and steepest price hike for a single iPhone model in its history.

Another major change is that this will be the first Apple keynote in 15 years not led by Tim Cook. New CEO Ternus will take the podium, unveiling the most significant iPhone design change in nearly a decade.

Apple (AAPL-US) opened higher but fell on Wednesday the 2nd, starting at $326.86, briefly rising to $328.40 before selling pressure pushed it down to a low of $323.53, closing down $0.46 or 0.14% at $324.50 per share.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走低 油價、債券殖利率漲勢降溫
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Weakens as Oil Prices and Bond Yields Cool
paras: 美元周三(2日)小幅走低，此前一日因避險需求升溫而走強。隨著油價與美債殖利率飆升勢頭暫歇，美元漲勢有所收斂。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報99.60。該指數周二上漲0.3%。
全球主權債券遭持續拋售的情況周三有所緩和，促使交易員重新回頭買進股票。美國公債殖利率以及全球其他主要10年期公債殖利率周二均觸及多年高點。10年期美債殖利率升至2023年11月以來最高水平，2年期美債殖利率則創2024年7月以來新高。
債券遭拋售主要受到多項因素推動，包括油價維持高檔引發的通膨疑慮、企業為建置AI基礎設施而大量舉債所引發的債務可持續性擔憂，以及各國財政債務不斷膨脹。殖利率上升會推高借貸成本，進而可能對消費者與企業造成壓力。較高利率的環境通常也有利美元走強。
周三美債殖利率曲線趨於穩定，10年期美債殖利率最新下跌1.2個基點至4.784%，2年期殖利率則下跌2.1個基點至4.373%。
在周五備受關注的8月非農就業報告公布前，市場也取得更多美國經濟與勞動市場數據。
ADP數據顯示，美國民間企業8月新增3.8萬個工作，低於市場預估的4.7萬個，也是今年1月以來最慢的就業成長速度。不過，強勁的美國製造業數據抵銷了ADP就業數據的疲弱。7月製造業新訂單月增0.9%，達6,636億美元，高於市場預估的0.7%增幅。
此外，聯準會(Fed)最新發布的褐皮書(Beige Book)顯示，自7月初以來，美國各地區經濟活動小幅成長，12個聯準會轄區中有10個回報經濟成長，幅度介於輕微至溫和之間。
另一方面，油價仍走高，但漲幅不如周二。11月到期布蘭特(Brent)原油期貨最新上漲0.6%，至每桶95.26美元，前一交易日大漲4.6%。
美國與伊朗緊張情勢升高至數周來最高，雙方軍事攻擊再度升溫。美國中央司令部周二表示，已完成新一輪對伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)目標的攻擊，包括防空設施、雷達系統及通訊設施。
加幣走強 加國央行維持利率不變
加幣周三上漲0.4%。稍早加拿大央行(BoC)宣布維持利率不變，但警告通膨風險已經升高，且與美國的貿易戰讓經濟成長前景更加不確定。
加拿大央行總裁Tiff Macklem指出，自7月上次利率決策以來，中東衝突似乎仍沒有更接近解決。他也強調，美國新關稅可能對經濟成長反彈構成風險，但他預期這些關稅不會對整體經濟活動水準造成重大直接影響。
紐幣兌美元下跌逾0.7%，創6月23日以來最差單日表現。
紐幣走弱原因是紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)公布貨幣政策決策。央行決策官員升息25個基點，但同時發布意外偏鴿的未來政策指引。
日元自160回升 日銀準備討論升息
日元兌美元走強，並自關鍵的160關口回升。日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)稍早在記者會上確認，央行將在9月討論升息，焦點將放在能源價格推升的物價壓力是否威脅中期物價穩定。
日本央行理事高田創(Hajime Takata)進一步強化市場的鷹派預期，主張採取更加靈活的升息路徑。
就在一天前，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)在北卡羅來納州舉行的G20會議期間，敦促日本官員採取「果斷」行動，解決日元持續疲弱的問題。

paras_en: The dollar slipped slightly on Wednesday (the 2nd) after having risen the previous day on heightened safe‑haven demand. With the surge in oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields pausing, the dollar’s advance has eased.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.1% to 99.60. The index had risen 0.3% on Tuesday.

The wave of selling in sovereign bonds eased on Wednesday, prompting traders to turn back to equities. U.S. Treasury yields and other major 10‑year sovereign yields had hit multi‑year highs on Tuesday. The 10‑year U.S. yield rose to its highest level since November 2023, while the 2‑year yield reached a new peak not seen since July 2024.

Bond sell‑offs were driven by several factors, including inflation worries from persistently high oil prices, concerns over debt sustainability as companies borrow heavily to build AI infrastructure, and the continual expansion of fiscal deficits worldwide. Higher yields raise borrowing costs, which can pressure consumers and businesses, and a higher‑rate environment generally supports a stronger dollar.
On Wednesday the U.S. yield curve steadied, with the 10‑year Treasury slipping 1.2 basis points to 4.784% and the 2‑year falling 2.1 basis points to 4.373%.
Ahead of the much‑watched August non‑farm payroll report due on Friday, the market also received additional U.S. economic and labor‑market data.

ADP data showed private‑sector employers added 38,000 jobs in August, well below the 47,000 forecast and the slowest growth since January this year. However, strong U.S. manufacturing data offset the weak ADP numbers. July manufacturing new orders rose 0.9% month‑over‑month to $663.6 billion, beating the 0.7% estimate.

In addition, the Federal Reserve’s latest Beige Book indicated that economic activity has grown modestly across the United States since early July, with 10 of the 12 Fed districts reporting growth ranging from slight to moderate.
Oil prices continued to rise, though the gains were smaller than on Tuesday. Brent crude futures for November delivery were up 0.6% at $95.26 a barrel, after a 4.6% jump the previous session.

U.S.–Iran tensions rose to their highest level in weeks, with military attacks intensifying again. The U.S. Central Command said on Tuesday it had completed a new round of strikes against targets of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, including air‑defense installations, radar systems and communications facilities.
Canadian dollar strengthens as Bank of Canada holds rates steady

The loonie rose 0.4% on Wednesday. Earlier, the Bank of Canada announced it would keep its policy rate unchanged but warned that inflation risks have risen and that the trade dispute with the United States adds uncertainty to the economic outlook.

Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem noted that, since the July rate decision, the Middle‑East conflict still shows no sign of resolution. He also stressed that new U.S. tariffs could pose a risk to an economic rebound, but he expects the tariffs will not have a major direct impact on overall economic activity.
The New Zealand dollar fell more than 0.7% against the U.S. dollar, marking its worst single‑day performance since June 23.

The kiwi’s weakness stemmed from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand’s policy decision. While officials raised the cash rate by 25 basis points, they simultaneously issued an unexpectedly dovish forward guidance.
Japanese yen rebounds from 160 level as BOJ readies rate‑hike discussion

The yen strengthened against the dollar, climbing back above the key 160 threshold. Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda earlier confirmed at a news conference that the central bank will discuss a rate hike in September, focusing on whether energy‑price‑driven inflation pressures threaten medium‑term price stability.
BOJ board member Hajime Takata further reinforced hawkish market expectations, advocating a more flexible path for future rate increases.
Just a day earlier, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, speaking at a G20 meeting in North Carolina, urged Japanese officials to take “decisive” action to address the yen’s persistent weakness.

paras: 美債殖利率自多年高點回落，加上油價漲勢趨緩，緩解市場對通膨與聯準會 (Fed) 升息的擔憂，美股週三 (2 日) 震盪走高。道瓊終場上漲 295 點，標普 500、那斯達克指數同步收紅，三大指數均終結連續 3 個交易日跌勢。
受到美伊戰火重燃、能源價格上揚影響，美債殖利率近期快速攀升，一度壓抑市場風險偏好。美國 10 年期公債殖利率週三盤中升至 4.818%，創 2023 年 11 月以來新高，隨後回吐漲幅，尾盤降至約 4.78%。
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯 (John Williams) 表示，目前沒有明確跡象顯示，Fed 必須在 9 月升息才能壓低通膨。他認為，近期債券殖利率走高可能反映美國經濟強勁，未必意味市場通膨預期正在惡化，相關談話也降低投資人對 9 月升息的押注。
國際油價仍處高檔，但盤中漲勢收斂，為股市提供喘息空間。西德州原油期貨上漲近 1%，收每桶 91.01 美元；布蘭特原油上漲約 1%，收每桶 95.63 美元。
美國再度空襲伊朗，引發市場擔憂衝突升級及荷姆茲海峽航運受阻。美國總統川普週三表示，新一輪對伊朗軍事行動可能不會持續太久，並重申美國已掌控荷姆茲海峽。
美國能源部長萊特 (Chris Wright) 表示，週一有超過 1,700 萬桶原油通過荷姆茲海峽，創美伊戰爭 2 月爆發以來最高紀錄，顯示這條重要能源航道的運輸量正在回升。
2日公布的「小非農」ADP就業報告顯示，美國民間企業 8 月新增 3.8 萬個職位，低於市場預估的 4.7 萬個。投資人正等待週五出爐的非農就業報告，以進一步研判 Fed 後續政策方向。
Fed 週三公布的褐皮書顯示，美國經濟活動近幾個月「溫和成長」，就業人數整體僅小幅增加，物價則溫和上揚。資料中心需求是支撐經濟成長的動力之一。
企業對未來幾個月的整體展望仍偏正面，但各產業信心不一。能源價格上漲、政策變化及國際衝突造成的不確定性，成為企業目前的主要疑慮。
美股週三 (2 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭多收高。Meta (META-US) 上漲 2.47%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 收低 0.052%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 漲 0.63%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 跌 0.84%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 漲0.024%。
費城半導體成分股互有消長。AMD (AMD-US) 跌0.55%；博通 (AVGO-US) 跌 0.66%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 3.21%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 跌 0.77%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 2.01%。

企業新聞
戴爾(DELL-US) 狂飆超15% 至每股 492.20 美元，成為標普500指數週三表現最佳的成分股。受AI熱潮推升產品需求帶動，公司第二季營收與獲利均優於分析師預期。

PG&E(PCG-US)大跌5.19% 至每股 13.33 美元。這家加州公用事業公司宣布啟動策略評估，並將針對公司的組織及融資方式「考慮所有可能方案」。市場目前高度關注公用事業公司可能承擔的野火相關責任。

華爾街分析

Hatfield認為，美伊達成和平協議的可能性不高，但近期油價漲勢可能不會持續太久。隨著非石油輸出國組織 (OPEC) 產油國提高產量，以及替代原油運輸路線逐步形成，預料油價未來6個月將轉為下行。他預估，標普500指數可能在7,500點附近觸底。

paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have retreated from multi‑year highs and the oil price rally has eased, relieving market concerns about inflation and Federal Reserve rate hikes. As a result, U.S. equities rose on Wednesday (the 2nd). The Dow Jones closed up 295 points, and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq both finished in the green, ending a three‑day losing streak for all three major indices.

Following the renewed fighting between the United States and Iran and the rise in energy prices, Treasury yields surged sharply, briefly suppressing market risk appetite. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose to 4.818% mid‑session on Wednesday, a new high since November 2023, before giving back some of the gain and ending the day around 4.78%.

New York Fed President John Williams said there is currently no clear indication that the Fed must raise rates in September to curb inflation. He believes the recent rise in bond yields may reflect a strong U.S. economy rather than worsening inflation expectations, and his comments have reduced investors’ bets on a September hike.

International oil prices remain elevated but the intraday rally has narrowed, giving equities some breathing room. West Texas Intermediate crude rose nearly 1% to $91.01 a barrel, while Brent crude gained about 1% to $95.63 a barrel.

The United States again carried out airstrikes on Iran, sparking market worries about an escalation of the conflict and potential disruptions to shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday that the new round of military action against Iran is unlikely to last long and reiterated that the U.S. has control of the Hormuz Strait.

Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that more than 17 million barrels of oil passed through the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, the highest volume since the war between the U.S. and Iran began in February, indicating that traffic on this key energy route is rebounding.

The ADP “non‑farm” employment report released on the 2nd showed that private‑sector jobs grew by 38,000 in August, well below the market expectation of 47,000. Investors are now awaiting Friday’s official non‑farm payrolls to gauge the Fed’s next policy move.

The Fed’s Beige Book released on Wednesday indicated that U.S. economic activity over the past few months has been “moderately expanding,” with employment adding only modestly and prices rising gently. Data‑center demand continues to be one of the drivers of growth.

Corporate outlooks for the coming months remain generally positive, though confidence varies across sectors. Higher energy prices, policy shifts and international conflicts are the main sources of uncertainty for companies at present.
U.S. equity market performance on Wednesday (the 2nd):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 295.07 points, or 0.56%, to 53,061.95.
The Nasdaq Composite gained 118.05 points, or 0.45%, to 26,217.83.
The S&P 500 climbed 35.21 points, or 0.46%, to 7,666.68.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 50.64 points, or 0.45%, to 11,339.25.
The NYSE FANG+ Index added 24.15 points, or 0.13%, to 18,582.38.

Focus stocks:
Among the five big‑tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index, most closed higher. Meta (META‑US) rose 2.47%; Apple (AAPL‑US) slipped 0.052%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) gained 0.63%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) fell 0.84%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) rose 0.024%.

Semiconductor component stocks showed mixed moves. AMD (AMD‑US) fell 0.55%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) dropped 0.66%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) jumped 3.21%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) slipped 0.77%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) rose 2.01%.
In the memory sector, Micron (MU‑US) climbed 2.43%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) slipped 0.34%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) rose 1.08%; Seagate (STX‑US) fell 0.99%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) gained 2.61%.
Taiwan‑related ADRs were mixed. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) rose 0.36%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) fell 0.94%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) dropped sharply 2.44%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) gained 0.56%.
Corporate news:

Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) surged more than 15% to $492.20 per share, making it the best‑performing S&P 500 component on Wednesday. Strong AI‑driven demand boosted second‑quarter revenue and earnings beyond analysts’ forecasts.

Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US) plunged 9.28% to $328.48, becoming the worst‑performing S&P 500 component of the day. The cybersecurity firm posted a strong fourth‑quarter report, but its stock, up over 83% year‑to‑date, saw investors take profits after the earnings release.
Uber (UBER‑US) rose more than 1.6% to $76.45. The ride‑hailing company announced it will cut roughly 10% of its global workforce as part of a broader corporate restructuring plan.

PG&E (PCG‑US) fell 5.19% to $13.33. The California utility said it is launching a strategic review and will consider all possible options for its organization and financing. The market is closely watching the potential wildfire‑related liabilities of utility firms.
Other California utility stocks weakened as well, with Edison International (EIX‑US) down 6.14% and Sempra (SRE‑US) slipping 0.58%.
Wall Street analysis:

Evercore analyst Krishna Guha noted that Williams’ remarks do not completely rule out a September rate hike, but they challenge the market’s previously high probability view of a hike at that meeting.

Edward Jones strategist Angelo Kourkafas assessed that after a tough start to September, U.S. equities are gradually finding footing. Fundamentals remain supportive; while seasonal headwinds merit attention, they are not enough to overturn the overall bullish trend.

Jay Hatfield, CEO of Infrastructure Capital Advisors, said oil prices are the key driver of market direction right now. The market’s rebound on Wednesday was mainly because the oil rally appears to be topping out, but the broader market may stay range‑bound during a seasonally weak period.

Hatfield believes the odds of a peace deal between the U.S. and Iran are low, but the recent oil price surge is unlikely to last long. With OPEC producers increasing output and alternative crude‑transport routes taking shape, he expects oil prices to turn lower over the next six months and projects the S&P 500 could find a bottom around the 7,500‑point level.

items.title: 川普：對伊朗新一輪轟炸不會拖太久 美軍想打隨時可再出手
items.title_en: Trump: New round of bombing Iran won’t last long; US forces ready to strike again anytime
paras: 多家外媒報導，美國總統川普週三 (2日) 表示，美伊恢復交火後，美方對伊朗展開的新一輪軍事行動不會持續太久，但美軍已做好再次攻擊的準備，「只要我們想，任何時候都能再出手」。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室接受記者提問時表示，伊朗正試圖重建雷達、飛彈系統，以及可用來投放水雷的火箭設備，美軍已摧毀其相關設施。他宣稱，美方前一晚發動的攻勢規模龐大，除了雷達外，也破壞伊朗在荷姆茲海峽沿岸新建的多項攻擊與防禦設施。
川普說，美軍此次出手是為回應伊朗攻擊美國位於約旦的基地。他形容伊朗的攻擊只是「輕輕碰了一下」，美方則予以猛烈反擊，並強調美軍已準備好隨時發動下一波攻勢。
被問及新一輪對伊朗軍事行動可能持續多久時，川普僅回答：「我認為不會太久。」
至於伊朗軍力已遭重創，美方還有哪些目標需要攻擊，他並未正面說明，而是轉而強調，美國目前對荷姆茲海峽擁有「非常強的控制力」。
川普宣稱，美方每天都在協助多艘載有數百萬桶石油的船隻駛離海峽，整體過程大致順利，伊朗偶爾發射無人機，美軍便會將其擊落。他也淡化油價再度升至每桶95美元的影響，表示價格之後將會回落。
美國中央司令部表示，美國海軍持續在荷姆茲海峽執行對伊朗的封鎖行動，截至週三已改變86艘商船的航向，高於前一天的84艘；美軍另使3艘船失去行動能力，並登上2艘船檢查，以確保相關船隻遵守規定。
美國國務卿盧比歐則表示，荷姆茲海峽將維持開放，美方也會繼續打擊任何對美軍及海峽國際航運構成立即威脅的目標。他並警告，任何協助伊朗建立資金籌措管道的國家，都可能面臨美國制裁。
另一方面，伊朗再將11艘船舶列入不符合通行規定的黑名單，使遭限制的船舶總數增至56艘。相關船隻若試圖通過海峽，可能面臨罰款、沒收或扣留，進一步加劇這條重要能源運輸航道的通行壓力。
區域緊張情勢也持續升高。沙烏地阿拉伯指控伊朗週一晚間攻擊駛經荷姆茲海峽的沙國超級油輪Sidr，造成2名菲律賓籍船員死亡。阿拉伯聯合大公國隨後譴責這起攻擊，並表示將商業航運作為經濟脅迫工具，已對區域穩定構成直接威脅。伊朗尚未回應沙國指控。
伊朗同時指控美軍飛彈碎片擊中南部錫里克一處舉辦婚禮的住宅，造成至少4人死亡、68人受傷。伊朗國營媒體稱，死者包括2名女性及2名分別為4歲和16歲的兒童。伊朗外交部發言人巴蓋伊指控美方犯下戰爭罪。
美國中央司令部發言人霍金斯 (Tim Hawkins) 表示，美軍正在了解相關報導，但未說明是否已展開正式調查。美方此前表示已注意到這項指控，並強調美軍不會以平民為攻擊目標。
面對戰事可能擴大的疑慮，川普向以色列媒體表示，以色列不必擔心美伊戰火重燃，並稱「我是總統，我會處理」。以色列國防部長卡茲則警告，若伊朗攻擊以色列，以軍將以強大武力回應。
以色列總理尼坦雅胡進一步表示，以色列在伊朗的任務「尚未完成」，並稱其目標是推翻伊朗政權，以軍飛行員隨時可以再次出動。不過，以色列目前未被認為參與近期美伊之間的交火。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media reported that U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday (the 2nd) that the new round of U.S. military action against Iran following the renewed U.S.-Iran fighting will not last long, but the U.S. military is prepared to strike again, "as long as we want, we can hit at any time."

Trump told reporters in the Oval Office that Iran is trying to rebuild radar and missile systems as well as rocket equipment for laying mines, and that the U.S. has destroyed those facilities. He claimed the offensive launched the night before was massive, damaging not only radars but also several newly built attack and defense installations along the Strait of Hormuz.

Trump said the U.S. strike was a response to an Iranian attack on the U.S. base in Jordan. He described Iran’s attack as a "light tap" and said the U.S. responded with a heavy blow, emphasizing that the U.S. military is ready to launch the next wave at any moment.
When asked how long the new round of military action against Iran might last, Trump replied simply, "I don’t think it will be long."
He did not specify what additional Iranian targets remain after the heavy damage to Iran’s forces, but instead stressed that the United States now has "very strong control" over the Strait of Hormuz.

Trump claimed the U.S. is helping several ships carrying millions of barrels of oil exit the strait each day, and that the overall process is proceeding smoothly. He said Iran occasionally launches drones, which the U.S. shoots down, and downplayed the impact of oil prices climbing back to $95 a barrel, saying prices will fall again later.

U.S. Central Command said the Navy continues its blockade of Iran in the Strait of Hormuz, having redirected 86 merchant vessels by Wednesday, up from 84 the day before; three ships were rendered inoperable and two were boarded for inspections to ensure compliance with regulations.

U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken said the Strait of Hormuz will remain open and the United States will keep targeting any immediate threats to U.S. forces or international shipping there. He warned that any country helping Iran raise funds could face U.S. sanctions.

Iran added 11 more vessels to its blacklist of ships that do not meet passage requirements, raising the total number of restricted ships to 56. Vessels attempting to transit the strait could face fines, seizure or detention, further increasing pressure on this key energy corridor.

Regional tensions are rising. Saudi Arabia accused Iran of attacking the Saudi supertanker Sidr in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday night, killing two Filipino crew members. The United Arab Emirates condemned the attack, saying the use of commercial shipping as an economic coercion tool poses a direct threat to regional stability. Iran has not responded to Saudi claims.

Iran also accused U.S. missile fragments of hitting a home in southern Sirik where a wedding was taking place, killing at least four people and injuring 68. State media said the dead included two women and two children aged four and 16. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Bagheri accused the United States of committing war crimes.

U.S. Central Command spokesperson Tim Hawkins said the military is reviewing the reports but did not say whether a formal investigation has been opened. The United States previously said it was aware of the allegation and stressed that U.S. forces do not target civilians.

Addressing concerns that the conflict could expand, Trump told Israeli media that Israel need not worry about a renewed U.S.-Iran war, saying, "I’m the president, I’ll handle it." Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant warned that if Iran attacks Israel, the Israeli military will respond with overwhelming force.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel’s mission regarding Iran is "not yet completed," adding that the goal is to overthrow the Iranian regime and that Israeli pilots are ready to fly again at any time. However, Israel is not currently considered to be involved in the recent U.S.-Iran clashes.

items.title: 不再是一夜交棒！蘋果CEO世代交替 看庫克如何用「適應期」助特納斯接班
items.title_en: No More One‑Night Hand‑off! Apple CEO Succession Shows How Cook Uses a “Transition Period” to Help Ternus Take Over
paras: 蘋果公司(AAPL-US)新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)周二(1日)接替庫克(Tim Cook)上任，庫克則將轉任董事會的執行董事長。這次權力交接的時機正逢公司人工智慧(AI)轉型的重要時機，專家認為，由更年輕、更加重視產品的執行長主導，將非常適合目前的蘋果。
蘋果正進入關鍵時刻，不只即將推出Apple Intelligence及具代理能力的Siri，同時，記憶體晶片供應鏈限制和蘋果自研晶片相關問題，也讓蘋果的產品發展藍圖更加複雜。
特納斯先前擔任蘋果硬體部門主管，具備與擅長營運管理的庫克不同的技能背景。投資人及蘋果愛好者都期待，特納斯能為公司帶來更多創新產品，以及結合裝置端AI能力的新功能。
Moor Insights and Strategy首席分析師Anshel Sag表示，在市場期待出現能滿足AI需求的新產品型態之際，一位更年輕、更加重視產品的執行長，將非常適合目前的蘋果。

年輕CEO

51歲的特納斯，以執行長的標準來看相當年輕。根據Korn Ferry的數據，他比一般執行長的平均年齡年輕整整10歲。
特納斯相對年輕，意味著他有更充裕的時間可以帶領蘋果度過下一波科技轉型。但這也可能代表他在地緣政治及董事會事務方面的經驗較不足，而這點正是庫克擔任執行董事長後，可能發揮作用的地方。
根據蘋果的說法，庫克轉任蘋果董事會執行董事長後，將「協助處理公司若干事務，包括與全球各地決策官員互動」。
分析師Sag說，庫克並沒有真正離開，這個新角色很可能包括管理蘋果與川普政府既有的關係，以及處理其他不直接影響產品團隊的行政事務。
過去10年來，庫克一直小心維繫與美國總統川普之間的關係，包括替公司爭取到重要的關稅豁免，蘋果則已承諾在未來數年持續投資美國本土製造業。
Sag指出，要維繫這些關係，需要審慎規畫權力交接。他將庫克持續參與公司事務形容為特納斯的「在職訓練」。
Sag說：「特納斯過去並沒有與各國元首會面之類的經驗。這將是他們兩人需要共同合作的領域，而特納斯也會隨著時間累積這些能力。」
事實上，在交接前的數個月，蘋果已開始讓特納斯更頻繁站上舞台。特納斯今年3月曾介紹蘋果的MacBook Neo，並且出席蘋果最近兩次財報電話會議。

新CEO需要適應期

組織管理專家認為，蘋果的執行長接班計畫，可說是企業標準流程的教科書案例。職場績效專家Henna Pryor表示，企業「最昂貴的留才失敗方式之一」，就是升遷一名員工，卻不讓他真正擁有決策權。
為了避免這種情況，許多公司都會設置一段「適應期」，讓高階主管逐步移交職責，而蘋果早在4月就宣布接班計畫，因此過去幾個月以來，庫克與特納斯似乎一直在進行這樣的交接準備。
Pryor表示，要讓一個人的工作職責在一夜之間完全改變，既不可能實現也不是合理的期待，「當我把自己的工作交接給新的人選時，並不只是告訴他『你升職了』。更重要的是，要明確說明哪些決策從第一天開始移交，以及哪些職責會在一段明確的適應期後才正式轉移。」
對蘋果而言，這次交接的風險尤其高。晨星(Morningstar)首席股票市場策略師Michael Field說：「執行長交接永遠存在風險，尤其是對那些由單一人物願景所驅動的公司。」投資人過去對賈伯斯交棒給庫克，也存在類似的看法。
Field認為，蘋果採取這種逐步交接方式，「可以避免市場受到衝擊」。庫克可以在幕後提供指導，而特納斯則能帶來新面孔及更深厚的硬體專業。
不過，Field也警告，這種安排可能存在缺點。「你也可以說，這可能是兩邊最糟糕的結果。如果你替換了一個人，卻沒有讓新的人真正完全掌舵、按照自己的想法做事，那麼你可能根本無法獲得應有的成長。」

不要先入為主解讀老闆的行為

紐約大學心理學教授、著有《Jerks at Work》的Tessa West則指出，在與老闆直接溝通前，不應自行替老闆的行為賦予特定意義，許多看似過度監督的行為，往往與老闆是否信任員工無關。
她說：「我們常常在進入一段對話時，已經先認定某種行為背後的原因，而不是直接詢問這個行為本身。你其實並不了解一個人行為背後所有可能的原因。」
West認為，針對哪些行動有助於改善工作流程及提高生產力，員工可以公開、明確的溝通，而不是先假設對方是在質疑自己的能力，把焦點放在行動本身，不要放在這個行動帶來的感受。
paras_en: Apple Inc. (AAPL‑US) announced that new chief executive John Ternus will succeed Tim Cook on Tuesday (the 1st), while Cook will move to the role of executive chairman of the board. The timing of this power transfer coincides with a crucial phase of Apple’s artificial‑intelligence (AI) transformation, and experts say a younger, more product‑focused CEO is a perfect fit for Apple’s current needs.

Apple is at a pivotal moment, not only about to launch Apple Intelligence and a more capable Siri, but also facing constraints in memory‑chip supply chains and challenges related to its own silicon, which make the company’s product roadmap increasingly complex.

Ternus previously headed Apple’s hardware division, bringing a skill set different from Cook’s operational management background. Investors and Apple enthusiasts alike are hoping Ternus will deliver more innovative products and new features that blend device‑side AI capabilities.

Anshel Sag, chief analyst at Moor Insights and Strategy, said that as the market looks for new product formats that satisfy AI demand, a younger, more product‑centric CEO is especially suited to Apple’s present situation.

Young CEO

At 51, Ternus is relatively young for a chief executive. According to Korn Ferry data, he is a full ten years younger than the average CEO age.

Ternus’s relative youth means he has more time to steer Apple through the next wave of technological transformation. However, it may also imply less experience in geopolitics and board affairs, areas where Cook’s continued presence as executive chairman could be valuable.
Apple says that after moving to the board’s executive chairmanship, Cook will “help handle various company matters, including interactions with decision‑makers around the world.”

Analyst Sag noted that Cook isn’t really leaving; the new role will likely involve managing Apple’s existing relationship with the Trump administration and handling other administrative tasks that do not directly affect product teams.

Over the past decade, Cook has carefully maintained ties with former U.S. President Donald Trump, securing key tariff exemptions for the company, while Apple has pledged to continue investing in U.S. domestic manufacturing for several years.
Sag pointed out that preserving these relationships requires careful planning of the power transition. He described Cook’s ongoing involvement as on‑the‑job training for Ternus.
“Ternus has not previously met heads of state,” Sag said. “That will be an area where the two of them need to cooperate, and Ternus will build those capabilities over time.”

In fact, in the months leading up to the hand‑over, Apple has already given Ternus a more frequent stage presence. In March, Ternus introduced the MacBook Neo and has participated in Apple’s two most recent earnings calls.

New CEO Needs a Transition Period

Organizational experts say Apple’s CEO succession plan is a textbook example of a standard corporate process. Workplace performance specialist Henna Pryor notes that one of the costliest talent‑retention failures is promoting an employee without granting real decision‑making authority.

To avoid that pitfall, many firms establish a “transition period” during which senior leaders gradually hand over responsibilities. Apple announced its succession plan in April, and over the past few months Cook and Ternus appear to have been preparing for exactly that hand‑over.

Pryor explains that it is neither feasible nor reasonable to expect a person’s job duties to change completely overnight. “When I hand over my role to a successor, I don’t just say ‘you’re promoted.’ It’s crucial to specify which decisions transfer from day one and which responsibilities shift after a clearly defined adaptation period.”

For Apple, the stakes are especially high. Morningstar chief equity strategist Michael Field said, “CEO transitions always carry risk, particularly for companies driven by a single visionary.” Investors expressed similar concerns when Steve Jobs passed the baton to Cook.
Field believes Apple’s phased hand‑over “can shield the market from shock.” Cook can provide guidance behind the scenes while Ternus brings a fresh face and deeper hardware expertise.

However, Field also warns that this arrangement has drawbacks. “You could argue it’s the worst of both worlds. If you replace a leader but don’t let the new person fully steer the ship according to their own vision, you may never achieve the growth you expect.”

Don’t Pre‑judge the Boss’s Actions

NYU psychology professor Tessa West, author of “Jerks at Work,” cautions that before directly communicating with a boss, one should avoid assigning specific meanings to the boss’s behavior; many actions that seem overly supervisory often have nothing to do with the boss’s trust in employees.

She says, “We often enter a conversation already assuming a reason behind a behavior instead of asking directly about the behavior itself. You don’t truly understand all possible reasons behind a person’s actions.”

West argues that employees should openly and clearly discuss actions that improve workflow and productivity, rather than assuming the boss is questioning their competence. Focus on the action itself, not the feelings it evokes.

items.title: 川普政府出招了！拒報非法移民恐失數十億美元聯邦福利資金
items.title_en: Trump Administration Takes Action: Refusal to Report Illegal Immigrants Could Cost Tens of Billions in Federal Welfare Funds
paras: 美國司法部祭出新解釋，要求所有接受聯邦福利資金的州政府機關，將已知非法居留者資訊通報國土安全部，否則可能面臨數十億美元聯邦補助遭削減的風險。這項政策被視為川普政府擴大移民執法、進一步要求州政府配合聯邦移民機關的重要一步，也可能引發民主黨主政州的新一輪法律挑戰。

美國司法部(Department of Justice, DOJ)法律顧問辦公室(Office of Legal Counsel, OLC)9月1日發布法律意見，重新解釋1996年「個人責任與工作機會調和法」(Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act, PRWORA)中的移民資訊通報規定，認定只要州政府選擇接受「貧困家庭臨時援助」(Temporary Assistance for Needy Families, TANF)及「補充保障收入」(Supplemental Security Income, SSI)相關聯邦資金，整個州政府所有機關都必須將已知未合法居留美國的人員資訊通報美國國土安全部(DHS)。
這代表通報義務不再只限於直接負責管理TANF或SSI計畫的州政府機構。根據司法部的新解釋，包括州立大學、汽車監理機關(DMV)等其他可能掌握移民身分資訊的州政府部門，只要知道相關人士處於非法居留狀態，也可能必須向DHS提供資訊。
司法部副助理司法部長Joshua Craddock在法律意見中表示，未遵守規定可能面臨「嚴重後果」，包括失去相關聯邦計畫資金。司法部強調，這項法律意見不是新的法律，而是恢復國會原先制定法規時的意義，並撤回1998年克林頓政府時期採取的較狹義解釋。
司法部助理司法部長T. Elliot Gaiser則表示，國會在1996年法律中已明確規定相關義務，州政府一旦選擇接受TANF資金，就必須遵守資訊通報要求。司法部認為，原本的1998年法律意見將「State」狹義解釋為負責執行福利計畫的特定州政府機關，縮小了國會原先設定的義務範圍，因此正式撤回該意見。
不過，這項新解釋採取「向前適用」原則，州政府過去依照1998年舊解釋所做的決定，不會因此遭到追溯處罰。司法部表示，聯邦機關將可依據新的法律標準，更新TANF及SSI的補助協議與合規程序。
目前全美50州、華盛頓特區以及多個美國領地都參與TANF及SSI相關計畫。司法部指出，TANF每年聯邦補助金超過164億美元，SSI聯邦福利支出則超過600億美元，因此若州政府拒絕配合，可能面臨相當龐大的聯邦資金壓力。
需要注意的是，無合法身分的移民本身並不符合TANF或SSI福利資格。這次政策的核心並非允許非法居留者取得福利，而是要求州政府把其他機關掌握的非法居留身分資訊交給聯邦移民執法機關。
新政策也可能擴大DHS取得移民資訊的來源。至少19州及華盛頓特區允許沒有合法移民身分的人申請駕照，因此州政府汽車監理機關可能掌握大量相關紀錄；此外，多個州立大學也招收沒有合法移民身分的學生。這意味著移民資訊可能不再只存在於福利機構，而是分散於州政府不同部門。
川普自2025年1月重返白宮後，持續推動大規模移民執法行動，包括擴大移民及海關執法局(ICE)行動、在多座城市部署移民執法人員，並尋求與州及地方執法機關合作，以追查涉嫌違反移民法的人員。近期聯邦政府也持續要求州政府提供駕照、選民名冊及其他政府資料，並以聯邦資金作為施壓手段。
這波政策已引發民主黨主政州與川普政府之間的法律衝突。就在司法部發布最新法律意見前一個月，紐約、加州、科羅拉多、伊利諾、麻州、明尼蘇達、紐澤西等23州及華盛頓特區，已就另一項TANF資料共享政策提告，反對聯邦政府擴大取得福利受領人的個人資料。該訴訟由紐約州等地方政府於8月3日向華盛頓特區聯邦法院提出，目前已提出初步禁制令申請。
這起訴訟涉及的是美國衛生與公共服務部(HHS)旗下兒童與家庭管理局(ACF)6月發布的資料政策。該政策擬擴大聯邦政府取得TANF受領人資料的權限，包括社會安全號碼、地址、移民身分等敏感資訊，並可能與DHS等其他聯邦機關共享。多州政府主張，這種資料共享超出聯邦政府對TANF的法定權限，也違反行政程序及聯邦隱私保護規定。
參與訴訟的州政府認為，若福利申請人擔心個人資料可能被交給移民執法機關，可能導致符合資格的家庭不敢申請福利，進而削弱TANF原本協助低收入家庭及兒童脫離貧困的政策目的。訴訟文件指出，TANF全美約涉及240萬名受助者。
這並非川普政府第一次以聯邦資金要求州政府配合移民政策。近年聯邦政府已在選民資料、食品援助及商業駕照資料等議題上，要求州政府提供更完整的個人資訊，部分民主黨主政州則透過法院阻止或限制資料共享。8月，伊利諾州等多州也針對聯邦政府要求取得約1700萬名商業駕照持有人資料的措施提出法律挑戰。
對川普政府而言，最新法律意見提供了一個更廣泛的法律依據，讓DHS可以透過州政府不同部門取得非法居留者資訊；對州政府而言，接受數十億美元聯邦補助與維持州政府對個人資料的管理權之間，則可能形成新的政策與法律拉鋸。
由於OLC法律意見對聯邦行政機關具有拘束力，但本身並不等同於國會通過的新法律，州政府若拒絕配合，最終是否真的會遭到削減TANF或SSI相關資金，以及這些資金條件是否符合美國憲法與相關聯邦法律，仍可能交由法院裁決。
在2026年期中選舉逼近之際，移民政策已成為川普政府與民主黨主政州之間的重要政治與法律戰場。最新通報要求若全面落地，將使州政府各部門與聯邦移民執法機關之間的資訊交換大幅增加，也可能成為下一波移民政策訴訟的焦點。
paras_en: The U.S. Department of Justice has issued a new interpretation requiring every state government agency that receives federal welfare funds to report known illegal residents to the Department of Homeland Security, or risk having tens of billions of dollars in federal aid cut. The policy is seen as a major step in the Trump administration’s effort to expand immigration enforcement and compel state cooperation with federal immigration authorities, and could spark a new round of legal challenges from Democratic‑led states.

On September 1, the Department of Justice’s Office of Legal Counsel released a legal opinion re‑interpreting the immigration‑information‑reporting provision of the 1996 Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act (PRWORA). The opinion holds that any state that chooses to accept federal money tied to Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI) must have all its agencies report any known persons residing in the United States illegally to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

This means the reporting duty is no longer limited to the state agencies that directly administer TANF or SSI. Under the DOJ’s new reading, other state entities that may possess immigration‑status information—such as state universities and motor‑vehicle departments (DMVs)—must also provide DHS with information on individuals they know to be unlawfully present.

Deputy Assistant Attorney General Joshua Craddock wrote in the opinion that failure to comply could have “serious consequences,” including loss of the related federal program funding. The DOJ stressed that the opinion does not create new law but restores the original congressional intent of the statute and revokes the narrower interpretation adopted in 1998 during the Clinton administration.

Assistant Attorney General T. Elliot Gaiser added that Congress explicitly mandated the reporting obligation in the 1996 law, and that any state that accepts TANF funds must obey it. The DOJ said the 1998 opinion had narrowly defined “State” to mean only the agencies that run the welfare programs, thereby shrinking the congressional duty, and that opinion is now formally withdrawn.

However, the new interpretation applies prospectively, so states’ past decisions made under the 1998 guidance will not be punished retroactively. The DOJ said federal agencies will be able to update TANF and SSI grant agreements and compliance procedures to reflect the new legal standard.

All 50 states, the District of Columbia and several U.S. territories currently participate in TANF and SSI programs. The DOJ noted that TANF receives more than $16.4 billion in federal assistance each year, while SSI expenditures exceed $60 billion, so a state that refuses to cooperate could face a substantial loss of federal dollars.

It is important to note that undocumented immigrants are not themselves eligible for TANF or SSI benefits. The policy’s focus is not to grant benefits to illegal residents but to require states to turn over immigration‑status information held by other agencies to federal immigration‑enforcement authorities.

The new rule could broaden DHS’s sources of immigration data. At least 19 states and D.C. allow people without legal immigration status to obtain driver’s licenses, meaning motor‑vehicle agencies may hold large numbers of relevant records. In addition, many state universities enroll students who lack legal status. Thus, immigration information may no longer be confined to welfare agencies but spread across various state departments.

Since returning to the White House in January 2025, Trump has continued to push large‑scale immigration‑enforcement actions, expanding ICE operations, deploying immigration officers in multiple cities, and seeking cooperation from state and local law‑enforcement to track alleged immigration‑law violators. The federal government has also been demanding state‑level data such as driver‑license rolls, voter registries and other records, using federal funding as leverage.

The policy has already sparked legal conflict between Democratic‑run states and the Trump administration. A month before the DOJ issued its latest opinion, New York, California, Colorado, Illinois, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey and 22 other states plus D.C. filed a lawsuit challenging a separate TANF data‑sharing rule that would expand federal access to beneficiaries’ personal information. The suit was filed by New York and other state officials on August 3 in a federal court in D.C., and a preliminary injunction has been sought.

The lawsuit concerns a data‑sharing policy issued in June by the Administration for Children and Families (ACF) within the Department of Health and Human Services. The policy would broaden federal access to TANF recipient data—including Social Security numbers, addresses and immigration status—and could allow sharing with DHS and other agencies. Several states argue that the rule exceeds the statutory authority granted to the federal government over TANF and violates administrative‑procedure and privacy statutes.

Participating states contend that if welfare applicants fear their personal data could be handed over to immigration enforcement, eligible families may avoid applying for benefits, undermining TANF’s purpose of helping low‑income families and children escape poverty. The filing notes that TANF serves roughly 2.4 million recipients nationwide.

This is not the first time the Trump administration has used federal funding to pressure states to cooperate on immigration matters. In recent years the federal government has sought state‑provided data on voter rolls, food‑aid recipients and commercial driver’s‑license holders, and Democratic‑led states have often blocked or limited such sharing through the courts. In August, Illinois and several other states challenged a federal request for data on about 17 million commercial‑license holders.

For the Trump administration, the new legal opinion provides a broader statutory basis for DHS to obtain illegal‑resident information from a variety of state departments. For states, weighing billions of dollars in federal aid against retaining control over personal data could create a new policy and legal tug‑of‑war.

Because OLC opinions are binding on federal agencies but do not carry the force of a congressional law, it remains uncertain whether a state that refuses to comply will actually see TANF or SSI funds reduced, and whether such conditions would survive constitutional and federal‑law scrutiny, likely leaving the issue to the courts.

As the 2026 midterm elections approach, immigration policy has become a key political and legal battleground between the Trump administration and Democratic‑run states. If the reporting requirement is fully implemented, information exchanges between state departments and federal immigration‑enforcement officials would expand dramatically, potentially becoming the focus of the next wave of immigration‑policy litigation.

items.title: 「川普幣」真的來了！1美元可拿來花 創美國現任總統首例
items.title_en: The “Trump Coin” Is Real! $1 Can Be Spent, a First for a Sitting U.S. President
paras: 多家媒體週三 (2日) 報導，美國總統川普如今不只活躍地出現在白宮、新聞與社群平台上，也正式進入美國人的口袋。美國鑄幣局推出印有川普肖像的1美元硬幣，使他成為美國史上首位登上日常流通硬幣的現任總統。
美國鑄幣局正式推出印有川普肖像的1美元硬幣，這批硬幣已投入市場流通，收藏版卷裝及袋裝產品也同步開賣。
這款硬幣是為紀念美國建國250週年而發行，預計鑄造約900萬枚。雖然面額只有1美元，但收藏價顯然不只1美元：每卷25枚售價61美元，100枚袋裝版本則售154.50美元。
想在日常找零時收到「川普幣」，可能需要一些運氣。1美元硬幣在美國的使用率遠低於紙鈔，市場流通量相對有限，鑄幣局也鼓勵民眾多留意手中的零錢。
收藏家還可尋找特殊版本。美國鑄幣局7月4日鑄造了25萬枚帶有「July 4th」特殊標記的硬幣，並將其隨機放入一般卷裝及袋裝產品中。
硬幣外觀呈金色，但實際上並不含黃金，主要成分為88.5%銅，另含少量鋅、錳及鎳。這批硬幣在費城鑄造，沒有鑄幣標記。
硬幣正面由美國鑄幣局首席雕刻師Joseph Menna設計，圖像取自白宮官方照片，川普近乎正面直視前方，上方刻有「LIBERTY」、「IN GOD WE TRUST」及「1776-2026」。
背面則採用前首席雕刻師Frank Gasparro創作的美國總統徽章，並在老鷹盾牌上加入數字「250」，象徵美國獨立250週年。
柯立芝曾登上硬幣 但並非日常流通款
川普不是第一位任內出現在美國硬幣上的總統。1926年，美國慶祝獨立150週年時，時任總統柯立芝曾與首任總統華盛頓一同登上半美元硬幣，成為首位出現在美國硬幣上的在世總統。
不過，柯立芝版本屬於紀念幣，並非為日常交易而發行。川普版則是可以實際使用的法定貨幣，因此創下美國現任總統登上日常流通硬幣的首例。
可以拿來花 法律依據卻有爭議
川普1美元硬幣已成為法定貨幣，但其法律依據仍受到質疑。美國長期避免將在世人物 (活人) 肖像放上貨幣，這項傳統可追溯至18世紀末。當時鑄幣局曾希望把華盛頓肖像放上貨幣，但遭到本人拒絕，理由是這種做法過於接近君主制。
美國國會1866年通過修正案，禁止紙鈔採用在世人物的肖像；其他貨幣法規及長期慣例，也對在世人物登上硬幣設有限制。不過，美國貨幣圖案受到多項法律規範，適用範圍並不完全一致。
川普政府援引《2020年流通收藏硬幣重新設計法》作為發行依據。這項法律由川普第一任期內簽署，允許鑄幣局在2026年發行採用美國建國週年象徵設計的1美元硬幣。
財長貝森特則以柯立芝為例，主張美國在獨立150週年時既然曾讓現任總統登上硬幣，建國250週年推出川普硬幣也有先例可循。
研究美國貨幣的美國大學經濟學副教授Gabriel Mathy對此持不同看法。他認為這款硬幣可被視為違法，但美國相關法律在實務上更接近難以執行的規範。
硬幣的設計程序同樣引發批評。美國美術委員會曾建議採用川普側面肖像及另一款老鷹圖案，但兩項建議均未獲採納；通常負責審查鑄幣設計的公民鑄幣諮詢委員會，則拒絕審議這款硬幣。
paras_en: Multiple media outlets reported on Wednesday (the 2nd) that President Donald Trump is now not only active at the White House, in the news and on social platforms, but has also officially entered Americans' wallets. The U.S. Mint has launched a $1 coin bearing Trump’s portrait, making him the first sitting president in U.S. history to appear on everyday circulating coinage.
The U.S. Mint officially released the $1 coin with Trump’s portrait, and the batch has already entered circulation. Collector’s rolls and bagged products are also on sale simultaneously.

The coin was issued to commemorate the United States’ 250th anniversary, with an expected mintage of about 9 million. Although its face value is only $1, the collector’s value is clearly higher: a roll of 25 coins sells for $61, and a 100‑coin bag sells for $154.50.

Receiving a “Trump coin” as everyday change may require some luck. $1 coins are used far less frequently than paper bills in the United States, so their market circulation is relatively limited, and the Mint encourages people to pay attention to the change they have on hand.
Collectors can also look for special versions. On July 4 the Mint struck 250,000 coins with a “July 4th” special mark, which are randomly placed in the regular rolls and bags.
The coin looks gold‑colored but contains no gold; it is made of 88.5 % copper with small amounts of zinc, manganese and nickel. The batch was minted in Philadelphia and carries no mint mark.

The obverse was designed by Joseph Menna, the Mint’s chief engraver, using an official White House photo. Trump is shown almost straight‑on, looking forward, with the legends “LIBERTY,” “IN GOD WE TRUST” and “1776‑2026” inscribed above.
The reverse uses the presidential seal created by former chief engraver Frank Gasparro, adding the number “250” to the eagle’s shield to symbolize the nation’s 250th anniversary of independence.
Hoover once appeared on a coin, but not as a regular‑issue circulating piece.

Trump is not the first president to appear on a U.S. coin while in office. In 1926, during the 150th‑anniversary celebrations, sitting President Calvin Hoover appeared alongside the first president George Washington on a half‑dollar coin, becoming the first living president to be featured on U.S. coinage.

However, Hoover’s coin was a commemorative issue, not intended for everyday transactions. The Trump version is legal tender that can actually be spent, making it the first instance of a sitting president on a circulating coin.
Can Be Spent – Legal Basis Remains Controversial

The Trump $1 coin is legal tender, but its statutory basis is disputed. The United States has long avoided placing living persons’ likenesses on currency, a tradition dating back to the late 18th century when the Mint wanted to put Washington’s portrait on money but he refused, citing concerns about monarchical overtones.

Congress passed an amendment in 1866 prohibiting the use of living persons’ images on paper money; other currency statutes and long‑standing practices also limit living individuals on coins. Yet U.S. coin‑design regulations are governed by multiple laws with varying scopes.

The Trump administration cited the 2020 Circulating Collectible Coin Redesign Act as the authority for the issue. That law, signed during Trump’s first term, permits the Mint to issue a $1 coin in 2026 featuring designs that commemorate the nation’s founding anniversary.

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen pointed to Hoover as precedent, arguing that since a sitting president appeared on a coin for the 150th anniversary, issuing a Trump coin for the 250th has historical precedent.

Gabriel Mathy, an associate professor of economics at a U.S. university who studies American money, disagrees. He believes the coin may be illegal, but notes that the relevant statutes are practically unenforceable.

The design process also drew criticism. The U.S. Commission of Fine Arts had suggested using a profile portrait of Trump and an alternative eagle design, but both proposals were rejected; the Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee, which normally reviews coin designs, refused to consider this coin.

items.title: DeepSeek只是開始！中國AI「老虎」ETF登場 瞄準估值趨同機會
items.title_en: DeepSeek Is Just the Beginning! China’s AI "Tigers" ETF Debuts, Targeting Valuation Convergence Opportunities
paras: 中國挑戰美國人工智慧(AI)主導地位的競爭，正逐漸從私募市場延伸至公開股票市場，讓ETF投資人開始有機會直接押注中國新興AI基礎模型開發商。EMXETF近期推出China AI Tigers LLM ETF(TGRZ-US)，鎖定中國AI模型開發領域，而非像傳統中國科技ETF一樣廣泛布局半導體、雲端運算、電子商務及其他科技產業。
EMXETF創辦人Kevin Carter表示，這檔ETF推出的時機與中國AI模型企業接連上市密切相關。Z.ai及MiniMax均在2026年1月上市，使原本主要存在於私人市場的中國AI模型投資題材首次大規模進入公開市場。
Carter接受Benzinga訪問時表示，「時機的關鍵在於那些IPO——Z.ai和MiniMax均於2026年1月上市，這使得中國人工智慧模型板塊驟然具備了投資價值。」他指出，TGRZ的設計也考慮到未來可能上市的中國AI模型公司，包括DeepSeek及Moonshot AI。
其中，Moonshot AI的上市動向尤其受到市場關注。這家Kimi系列AI模型開發商據報正考慮在香港進行IPO，近期並已籌集超過20億美元資金。Reuters此前報導，Moonshot也已與微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)展開初步洽談，討論圍繞Kimi K3模型的潛在收入分成協議。
若DeepSeek、Moonshot等未上市AI模型公司未來進入公開市場，將進一步擴大中國AI模型企業可供全球投資人直接交易的範圍。對TGRZ而言，這類潛在新股正是ETF希望透過季度再平衡機制納入的標的。
Carter對「中國AI老虎」的定義相當明確。他認為，AI老虎應該是正在建立基礎AI模型的企業，而不是單純使用AI技術的公司，也不是提供晶片、雲端運算等更廣泛AI基礎設施的企業。
他指出，許多中國AI新創與清華大學存在密切關聯，而清華大學已成為中國重要AI研究及實驗室的人才與技術來源之一。例如Z.ai便源自清華研究體系；Moonshot AI創辦人楊植麟(Yang Zhilin)則曾在清華大學師從Z.ai聯合創辦人、清華大學教授唐傑(Tang Jie)。
Carter認為，市場可能仍然低估中國AI模型的實際進展。他表示，「最大的誤解是中國仍在追趕。」在他看來，部分中國AI模型目前已經接近甚至達到全球前沿水準，而且美國企業已經開始建立在這些中國模型之上並實際使用。
這項判斷也構成TGRZ背後最重要的投資論述之一。Carter認為，美中AI模型開發商之間存在巨大的估值差距，目前沒有一家中國AI模型開發商的估值超過1000億美元，但美國AI實驗室正在尋求遠高於此的估值，因此市場可能出現一項「估值趨同交易」。
Carter表示，「可以說，前方存在一種趨同交易機會。」他的核心觀點是，如果中國AI模型能力持續逼近全球前沿，而中國模型開發商的商業化速度及市場滲透率同步提升，中美AI企業之間巨大的估值落差可能逐步縮小。
不過，中國AI模型企業並不一定符合傳統意義上的「便宜」標準。以Z.ai為例，該公司2026年上半年營收達9.539億元人民幣(約1.419億美元)，較去年同期大增400%，但同期仍錄得20億元人民幣(約2.976億美元)淨虧損，研發支出更高達21億元人民幣(約3.124億美元)。
換言之，Z.ai雖然營收增速極快，但為維持AI模型研發及競爭力，公司仍需要投入龐大資金。這也反映中國AI模型產業目前的共同特徵，即營收高速成長與巨額研發支出並存，短期獲利能力仍然受到考驗。
另一家已上市的AI模型開發商MiniMax則在2026年1月於香港上市後受到投資人追捧，上市首日股價一度較發行價翻倍以上，收市時公司市值約137億美元。MiniMax的市場表現顯示，投資人對中國AI模型企業的成長潛力已經產生相當高的興趣。
TGRZ與傳統中國科技ETF的最大差異，在於其並不追求分散持有整個中國科技產業。該ETF的年度費用率為0.86%，投資策略是集中押注中國領先AI模型開發商。
Carter表示，「這不是一隻多元化中國科技基金，而是對中國領先AI模型開發公司的集中押注。」因此，TGRZ投資人承擔的並非整體中國科技股表現，而是中國AI模型產業能否持續突破、商業化及估值重估的集中風險。
這項策略也與中國目前發展AI的路線有關。DeepSeek在全球AI市場掀起的衝擊，已經證明前沿AI模型未必需要完全複製美國企業動輒數百億美元的資本支出模式。中國AI企業更加強調開源、可客製化及低成本模型，可能形成與美國大型AI企業不同的商業模式。
Carter認為，成本優勢可能成為中國AI模型擴大使用的重要武器。他表示，「中國正在採取不同的路線——開放、可客製化，而且成本大幅降低的AI，可以遠遠超出中國本土市場擴散。我認為兩種路線都有巨大的成長空間。」
這也意味著，中國AI產業的競爭優勢未必只來自模型能力，而可能同時來自價格。若中國企業能以較低的訓練及推理成本提供接近全球前沿水準的模型，將有機會推動AI應用從大型企業進一步擴展至更多中小企業及開發者。
不過，中國AI產業仍受到美國出口管制、先進晶片取得、算力基礎設施及地緣政治等因素影響。即使模型開發商能在演算法及成本控制方面取得突破，能否持續取得足夠算力，仍是影響其長期競爭力的重要變數。
TGRZ將採取季度再平衡機制，意味著基金未來可以隨著中國AI模型產業上市版圖擴大，調整持股組合並納入新的上市公司。對投資人而言，這項機制尤其重要，因為目前中國最受矚目的部分AI模型公司仍處於私人市場。
Carter明確表示，DeepSeek及Moonshot AI正是這檔ETF未來希望捕捉的上市標的。若這些企業最終完成IPO，投資人便不必再透過私募基金或風險投資渠道參與中國AI模型產業，而可以直接透過公開市場及ETF取得相關曝險。
從更大的產業格局來看，中國AI投資題材正在出現結構性轉變。過去投資中國AI通常需要透過晶片製造、雲端服務、伺服器、電子商務或大型科技企業間接參與；如今隨著Z.ai及MiniMax上市，AI基礎模型本身開始成為可以直接交易的資產類別。
TGRZ的推出因此不只是新增一檔中國科技ETF，更反映全球資本市場開始嘗試重新定價中國AI模型產業。若中國AI模型持續縮小與美國前沿模型的技術差距，而中國企業的估值仍大幅低於美國同業，Carter所稱的「估值趨同交易」確實可能成為未來市場關注的投資主題。
但另一方面，Z.ai巨額虧損、研發支出快速增加，以及中國AI產業高度依賴持續資本投入，也提醒投資人，技術突破並不必然等同於商業獲利。對TGRZ而言，未來真正的考驗將是這些AI模型開發商能否把快速增加的使用量及技術能力轉化為穩定營收與長期利潤。
隨著DeepSeek、Moonshot AI等潛在重量級玩家可能加入公開市場，中國AI模型產業的投資版圖正在快速成形。對全球投資人而言，這場AI競賽可能不再只是「美國模型對中國模型」的技術較量，也將逐漸演變成一場圍繞成本、商業化速度及估值差距的資本市場競賽。
paras_en: China’s challenge to U.S. AI dominance is gradually extending from the private market to the public equity market, giving ETF investors a chance to bet directly on emerging Chinese AI large‑language model developers. EMXETF recently launched the China AI Tigers LLM ETF (TGRZ‑US), focusing on the Chinese AI model development sector rather than broadly covering semiconductors, cloud computing, e‑commerce, and other tech industries like traditional China tech ETFs.

EMXETF founder Kevin Carter said the timing of this ETF launch is closely tied to the successive listings of Chinese AI model companies. Z.ai and MiniMax both went public in January 2026, bringing the previously private Chinese AI model investment theme into the public market on a large scale.

In an interview with Benzinga, Carter explained that the key timing was those IPOs—Z.ai and MiniMax both listed in January 2026—making the Chinese AI model sector suddenly attractive to investors. He noted that TGRZ’s design also considers future Chinese AI model companies that may go public, such as DeepSeek and Moonshot AI.

Moonshot AI’s listing prospects have drawn particular market attention. The Kimi‑series AI model developer reportedly plans an IPO in Hong Kong and has recently raised over $2 billion. Reuters previously reported that Moonshot has also begun preliminary talks with Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) about potential revenue‑share agreements around the Kimi K3 model.

If unlisted AI model companies like DeepSeek and Moonshot eventually enter the public market, the range of Chinese AI model firms available for global investors to trade directly will expand further. For TGRZ, these potential new stocks are exactly the targets the ETF aims to add through its quarterly rebalancing mechanism.

Carter’s definition of a "China AI tiger" is very clear. He believes an AI tiger should be a company building foundational AI models, not merely a firm using AI technology, nor one providing broader AI infrastructure such as chips or cloud computing.

He pointed out that many Chinese AI startups are closely linked to Tsinghua University, which has become one of China’s key AI research and laboratory talent and technology sources. For example, Z.ai originates from the Tsinghua research system; Moonshot AI founder Yang Zhilin previously studied under Z.ai co‑founder and Tsinghua professor Tang Jie.

Carter believes the market may still underestimate the actual progress of Chinese AI models. He said, "The biggest misconception is that China is still catching up." In his view, some Chinese AI models are already approaching or even reaching global frontier levels, and U.S. companies are already building on and using these Chinese models.

This judgment also forms one of the most important investment theses behind TGRZ. Carter argues that there is a huge valuation gap between U.S. and Chinese AI model developers; currently no Chinese AI model developer is valued above $100 billion, while U.S. AI labs are seeking valuations far higher, creating a potential "valuation convergence trade."

Carter said, "It can be said that there is a convergence trade opportunity ahead." His core view is that if Chinese AI model capabilities continue to close the gap with global frontiers, and if Chinese model developers’ commercialization speed and market penetration rise in tandem, the large valuation disparity between U.S. and Chinese AI firms may gradually shrink.

However, Chinese AI model companies may not necessarily meet the traditional notion of "cheap." Taking Z.ai as an example, the company’s revenue in the first half of 2026 reached 953.9 million yuan (about $141.9 million), a 400% increase year‑on‑year, but it still recorded a net loss of 2 billion yuan (about $297.6 million) and R&D spending of 2.1 billion yuan (about $312.4 million).

In other words, although Z.ai’s revenue growth is rapid, the company still needs to invest huge funds to maintain AI model R&D and competitiveness. This reflects a common feature of the Chinese AI model industry: rapid revenue growth coexists with massive R&D outlays, and short‑term profitability remains uncertain.

Another listed AI model developer, MiniMax, was well received by investors after its Hong Kong IPO in January 2026. On its first day of trading, the share price more than doubled the issue price, and the company’s market value closed at about $13.7 billion. MiniMax’s market performance shows that investors have a strong interest in the growth potential of Chinese AI model firms.

The biggest difference between TGRZ and traditional China tech ETFs is that it does not seek to diversify across the entire Chinese tech industry. The ETF’s annual expense ratio is 0.86%, and its investment strategy is to concentrate bets on leading Chinese AI model developers.

Carter said, "This is not a diversified China tech fund, but a concentrated bet on leading Chinese AI model developers." Therefore, TGRZ investors are not exposed to the overall performance of Chinese tech stocks, but to the concentrated risk of whether the Chinese AI model industry can continue to break through, commercialize, and be revalued.

This strategy also relates to China’s current AI development path. The impact of DeepSeek on the global AI market has shown that cutting‑edge AI models do not necessarily need to replicate the U.S. model of spending hundreds of billions of dollars in capital. Chinese AI firms emphasize open source, customization, and low‑cost models, potentially forming a business model different from large U.S. AI companies.

Carter believes cost advantage could become an important weapon for expanding the use of Chinese AI models. He said, "China is taking a different path—open, customizable, and significantly lower cost AI can far exceed domestic market diffusion. I believe both paths have huge growth potential."

This also means that China’s AI industry competitive advantage may not come solely from model capability, but also from price. If Chinese firms can offer near‑global frontier models at lower training and inference costs, they will have the opportunity to push AI applications beyond large enterprises to more SMEs and developers.

However, China’s AI industry is still affected by U.S. export controls, advanced chip acquisition, computing infrastructure, and geopolitical factors. Even if model developers achieve breakthroughs in algorithms and cost control, whether they can continue to secure sufficient computing power remains an important variable affecting long‑term competitiveness.

TGRZ will adopt a quarterly rebalancing mechanism, meaning the fund can adjust its holdings and add new listed companies as China’s AI model industry expands. For investors, this mechanism is especially important because many of China’s most watched AI model companies remain in the private market.

Carter made it clear that DeepSeek and Moonshot AI are the listings the ETF hopes to capture in the future. If these companies ultimately complete IPOs, investors will no longer need to participate in China’s AI model industry through private equity or venture capital channels, but can directly gain exposure through the public market and ETF.

From a larger industry perspective, the Chinese AI investment theme is undergoing a structural shift. In the past, investing in Chinese AI typically required indirect participation through chip manufacturing, cloud services, servers, e‑commerce, or large tech companies. Now, with Z.ai and MiniMax listed, the AI foundational models themselves have become a tradable asset class.

The launch of TGRZ is therefore not just a new China tech ETF, but also reflects global capital markets beginning to reprice the Chinese AI model industry. If Chinese AI models continue to close the technical gap with U.S. frontiers and Chinese firms remain vastly undervalued relative to U.S. peers, the "valuation convergence trade" Carter mentions could indeed become a future market focus.

On the other hand, Z.ai’s massive losses, rapidly increasing R&D spending, and the industry’s heavy reliance on continuous capital investment remind investors that technological breakthroughs do not necessarily translate into commercial profitability. For TGRZ, the real test will be whether these AI model developers can convert rapidly increasing usage and technical capability into stable revenue and long‑term profit.

As potential heavyweight players like DeepSeek and Moonshot AI may join the public market, the investment landscape of China’s AI model industry is rapidly taking shape. For global investors, this AI race may no longer be just a "U.S. model versus Chinese model" technical showdown, but will gradually evolve into a capital market competition around cost, commercialization speed, and valuation gaps.
